        "contents": "# Audion Base Path Konfiguration\n\n## Übersicht\n\nAudion wurde so konfiguriert, dass es unter dem Pfad &#96;/audion&#96; läuft, um parallelen Betrieb mit anderen Services auf derselben Maschine zu ermöglichen (z.B. ein anderer Service unter &#96;/dashboard&#96;).\n\n## Konfiguration\n\n### Nginx (&#96;infrastructure/nginx/nginx.conf&#96;)\n\nAlle Audion-Routen wurden von &#96;/&#96; auf &#96;/audion&#96; verschoben:\n\n- **Web App**: &#96;/audion/&#96; → &#96;http://web:3000&#96;\n- **Chat API**: &#96;/audion/api/chat&#96; → &#96;http://chat-api:8001&#96;\n- **Voice API**: &#96;/audion/api/voice&#96; → &#96;http://chat-api:8001&#96;\n- **Persona Backend**: &#96;/audion/api/persona-backend&#96; → &#96;http://persona-api:8000&#96;\n- **Indexing API**: &#96;/audion/api/indexing&#96; → &#96;http://indexing-api:8000&#96;\n\n**Wichtig**: Neo4j und Qdrant bleiben global unter &#96;/neo4j/&#96; und &#96;/qdrant/&#96; erreichbar.\n\n### Next.js (&#96;apps/web/next.config.mjs&#96;)\n\nDer &#96;basePath&#96; wurde hinzugefügt:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\nbasePath: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH || '/audion'\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nDies stellt sicher, dass Next.js alle internen Routen und Assets korrekt unter &#96;/audion&#96; serviert.\n\n### Docker Compose (&#96;infrastructure/compose.yml&#96;)\n\nAlle öffentlichen URLs wurden aktualisiert:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;yaml\nenvironment:\n  NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH: /audion\n  NEXT_PUBLIC_INDEXING_API_URL: https://192.168.50.101/audion/api/indexing\n  NEXT_PUBLIC_CHAT_API_URL: https://192.168.50.101/audion/api/chat\n  NEXT_PUBLIC_WS_BASE_URL: wss://192.168.50.101/audion/api/chat\n  NEXT_PUBLIC_PERSONA_BACKEND_URL: https://192.168.50.101/audion/api/persona-backend\n  NEXT_PUBLIC_PERSONA_BACKEND_DOCS_URL: https://192.168.50.101/audion/api/persona-backend/docs\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## URLs nach Migration\n\n### Audion Services\n- **Web App**: &#96;https://192.168.50.101/audion/&#96;\n- **Chat API**: &#96;https://192.168.50.101/audion/api/chat&#96;\n- **Voice API**: &#96;https://192.168.50.101/audion/api/voice&#96;\n- **Persona Backend**: &#96;https://192.168.50.101/audion/api/persona-backend&#96;\n- **Persona Docs**: &#96;https://192.168.50.101/audion/api/persona-backend/docs&#96;\n- **Indexing API**: &#96;https://192.168.50.101/audion/api/indexing&#96;",

    {
      "codeBlock": {

        "contents": "# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1.7\n\nARG NODE_IMAGE=node:22.11.0-alpine\n\nFROM ${NODE_IMAGE} AS base\nWORKDIR /app\nENV NODE_ENV=development \\\n    NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 \\\n    NEXT_CACHE_DIR=/app/apps/web/.next/cache\nRUN corepack enable &amp;&amp; npm config set fund false &amp;&amp; npm config set audit false\n\nFROM base AS deps\nCOPY package.json package-lock.json ./\nCOPY tsconfig.base.json ./\nCOPY apps/web/package.json apps/web/\nCOPY packages/types/package.json packages/types/\nRUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.npm npm ci --include-workspace-root --install-links\n\nFROM deps AS builder\nARG RUN_WEB_BUILD=false\nCOPY packages/types packages/types\nCOPY apps/web apps/web\nRUN npm run build --workspace packages/types\nRUN mkdir -p apps/web/.next\nRUN --mount=type=cache,target=/tmp/.next-cache \\\n    sh -c 'if [ \"${RUN_WEB_BUILD}\" = \"true\" ]; then npm run build:web; else echo \"Skipping Next.js build\"; fi'\n\nFROM base AS runner\nCOPY --from=deps /app/node_modules ./node_modules\nCOPY package.json package-lock.json ./\nCOPY tsconfig.base.json ./\nCOPY packages/types packages/types\nCOPY --from=builder /app/packages/types/dist ./packages/types/dist\nCOPY apps/web apps/web\nCOPY --from=builder /app/apps/web/.next ./apps/web/.next\nEXPOSE 3000\nCMD [\"npm\", \"run\", \"dev:web\"]",

        "contents": "### 3. Qdrant (Separate App)\n\n**Docker Image:** &#96;qdrant/qdrant:v1.11.3&#96;\n\n**Environment Variables:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nQDRANT__SERVICE__HTTP_PORT=6333\nQDRANT__SERVICE__GRPC_PORT=6334\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Persistent Volume:**\n- Path: &#96;/qdrant/storage&#96;\n- Coolify Persistent Storage\n\n**Public URL:** &#96;http://qdrant.{domain}/&#96; (über Traefik)\n\n### 4. Neo4j (Separate App)\n\n**Docker Image:** &#96;neo4j:5.22.0&#96;\n\n**Environment Variables:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nNEO4J_AUTH=neo4j/{NEO4J_PASSWORD}\nNEO4J_PLUGINS=[\"apoc\"]\nNEO4J_dbms_security_procedures_unrestricted=apoc.*\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Persistent Volume:**\n- Path: &#96;/data&#96;\n- Coolify Persistent Storage\n\n**Ports:**\n- HTTP: 7474\n- Bolt: 7687\n\n### 5. Tempo (Optional, Observability)\n\n**Docker Image:** &#96;grafana/tempo:2.6.0&#96;\n\n**Config File:** Via Volume Mount oder ConfigMap\n**Port:** 4318 (OTLP)\n\n---\n\n## Application Konfigurationen\n\n### 1. persona-web (Next.js Frontend)\n\n**Build Configuration:**\n- **Buildpack:** Dockerfile\n- **Dockerfile:** &#96;apps/web/Dockerfile&#96;\n- **Build Context:** Repository Root\n- **Build Args:**\n  - &#96;NODE_IMAGE=node:22.11.0-alpine&#96;\n  - &#96;RUN_WEB_BUILD=true&#96;\n\n**Environment Variables:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Public URLs (Coolify generiert automatisch)\nNEXT_PUBLIC_INDEXING_API_URL=https://indexing-api.{domain}/api/indexing\nNEXT_PUBLIC_CHAT_API_URL=https://chat-api.{domain}/api/chat\nNEXT_PUBLIC_WS_BASE_URL=wss://chat-api.{domain}/api/chat\nNEXT_PUBLIC_PERSONA_BACKEND_URL=https://persona-api.{domain}/api/persona-backend\nNEXT_PUBLIC_PERSONA_BACKEND_DOCS_URL=https://persona-api.{domain}/api/persona-backend/docs\n\n# Internal URLs (für Server-Side Requests)\nNEXT_BACKEND_INTERNAL_URL=http://coolify-internal-indexing-api:8000\nNEXT_CHAT_API_INTERNAL_URL=http://coolify-internal-chat-api:8001\nNEXT_PERSONA_BACKEND_INTERNAL_URL=http://coolify-internal-persona-api:8000\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Port:** 3000\n**Health Check:** &#96;GET /&#96;\n\n**Traefik Labels (via Coolify UI):**\n- Domain: &#96;persona-chat.{domain}&#96;\n- Path: &#96;/&#96;\n\n### 2. persona-api (FastAPI Backend)\n\n**Build Configuration:**\n- **Buildpack:** Dockerfile\n- **Dockerfile:** &#96;apps/api/Dockerfile&#96;\n- **Build Context:** Repository Root\n\n**Environment Variables:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",

        "contents": "- **Indexing API**: &#96;https://192.168.50.101/audion/api/indexing&#96;\n\n### Globale Services (unverändert)\n- **Neo4j Browser**: &#96;https://192.168.50.101/neo4j/browser&#96;\n- **Qdrant Dashboard**: &#96;https://192.168.50.101/qdrant/&#96;\n\n## Deployment\n\nNach den Änderungen müssen folgende Schritte ausgeführt werden:\n\n1. **Nginx neu laden**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   docker exec persona-nginx nginx -s reload\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n   Oder Container neu starten:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   docker-compose restart nginx\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. **Web-Container neu bauen** (wichtig für basePath):\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   docker-compose build web\n   docker-compose up -d web\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n3. **Services neu starten**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   docker-compose restart web nginx\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Testing\n\nNach dem Deployment sollte überprüft werden:\n\n- ✅ &#96;https://192.168.50.101/audion/&#96; zeigt die Audion-Startseite\n- ✅ &#96;https://192.168.50.101/dashboard&#96; zeigt weiterhin den anderen Service\n- ✅ API-Endpunkte funktionieren unter &#96;/audion/api/...&#96;\n- ✅ WebSocket-Verbindungen funktionieren\n- ✅ Alle internen Links und Assets werden korrekt geladen\n\n## Rückgängig machen\n\nFalls die Migration rückgängig gemacht werden soll:\n\n1. Nginx-Konfiguration: Alle &#96;/audion&#96; Routen zurück zu &#96;/&#96; ändern\n2. Next.js Config: &#96;basePath&#96; entfernen oder auf &#96;''&#96; setzen\n3.     {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./infrastructure/nginx/nginx.conf",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 34
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 73
          }
        },
        "contents": "    }\n\n    # HTTPS server\n    server {\n        listen 443 ssl;\n        http2 on;\n        server_name 192.168.50.101;\n        client_max_body_size 200m;\n\n        ssl_certificate /etc/nginx/ssl/cert.pem;\n        ssl_certificate_key /etc/nginx/ssl/key.pem;\n        ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;\n        ssl_ciphers HIGH:!aNULL:!MD5;\n\n        # Audion Web application - unter /audion\n        # Wichtig: /audion/ muss vor /audion kommen (spezifischere Route zuerst)\n        location /audion/ {\n            # Remove /audion prefix before passing to Next.js\n            rewrite ^/audion(.*)$ $1 break;\n            proxy_pass http://web;\n            proxy_http_version 1.1;\n            proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;\n            proxy_set_header Connection 'upgrade';\n            proxy_set_header Host $host;\n            proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;\n            proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;\n            proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;\n            proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Prefix /audion;\n            proxy_cache_bypass $http_upgrade;\n        }\n\n        # Redirect /audion to /audion/ (trailing slash handling)\n        location = /audion {\n            return 301 /audion/;\n        }\n\n        # Chat API - unter /audion/api/chat\n        location /audion/api/chat {\n            rewrite ^/audion/api/chat(.*)$ /chat$1 break;",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },

          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 27228
          },
          {
            "text": "docker logs persona-web --tail 2 | grep -E \"GET|HEAD\"",

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27231
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 27232
          },
          {
            "text": " GET / 200 in 41ms (compile: 9ms, render: 32ms)",
            "lineNumber": 27233
          },
          {
            "text": " HEAD / 200 in 51ms (compile: 9ms, render: 43ms)",
            "lineNumber": 27234
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27235
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",

          },

          },
          {
            "text": "---",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27241
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27242
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27243
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 27244
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27245
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27246
          },
          {
            "text": "Problem behoben. Audion ist unter &#96;https://192.168.50.101/audion/&#96; erreichbar.",
            "lineNumber": 27247
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27248
          },
          {
            "text": "**Zusammenfassung der LĂśsung:**",
            "lineNumber": 27249
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27250
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **Next.js basePath entfernt**: &#96;basePath&#96; in &#96;next.config.mjs&#96; auskommentiert und &#96;NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH&#96; in &#96;compose.yml&#96; auf leeren String gesetzt",
            "lineNumber": 27251
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **Nginx rewrite-Regel**: &#96;/audion/&#96; wird zu &#96;/&#96; umgeschrieben, bevor es an Next.js weitergeleitet wird",
            "lineNumber": 27252
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **X-Forwarded-Prefix Header entfernt**: Dieser Header hat Next.js zu einem Redirect veranlasst",
            "lineNumber": 27253
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27254
          },
          {
            "text": "Die Seite lĂ¤dt jetzt mit HTTP 200 und zeigt die Audion-Homepage. Beide Services (Echon unter &#96;/dashboard&#96; und Audion unter &#96;/audion/&#96;) kĂśnnen parallel laufen.",
            "lineNumber": 27255
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27256
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 27257
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27258
          },
          {
            "text": "_**User**_",
            "lineNumber": 27259
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27260
          },
          {
            "text": "mĂźssten wir nicht die anderen ebenfalls umstellen?",
            "lineNumber": 27261
          },
          {
            "text": "https://192.168.50.101/admin/target-groups  redirectet auch sofort",
            "lineNumber": 27262
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27263
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 27264
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27265
          },
          {
            "text": "_**Agent (model default, mode Agent)**_",
            "lineNumber": 27266
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27267
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27268
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27269
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 27270
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27271
          },
          {
            "text": "PrĂźfe die Nginx-Konfiguration und die Routen, die ebenfalls angepasst werden mĂźssen:",
            "lineNumber": 27272
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27273
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27274

            "lineNumber": 27275
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27276
          },
          {
            "text": "&lt;tool-use data-tool-type=\"read\" data-tool-name=\"read_file_v2\"&gt;",

        "contents": "### Problem: TypeScript Fehler im Build\n\n**Lösung:**\n1. Types Package bauen:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   npm run build --workspace packages/types\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. Prüfe TypeScript Errors:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   npm run typecheck --workspace apps/web\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Rollback (Falls nötig)\n\nFalls etwas schief geht:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 1. Assets werden ohne `/audion`-Prefix generiert, aber unter `/audion/_next/...` gesucht. Das funktioniert nicht.

Lösung: Next.js mit `basePath` behalten und Nginx so konfigurieren, dass der Prefix korrekt weitergeleitet wird. Teste einen anderen Ansatz mit `rewrite` ohne `break`:

| Web Search Results |  | To configure Nginx to proxy requests while preserving the original URI and removing a specific prefix without causing a redirect, you can utilize the `proxy_pass` directive effectively. Here's how you can achieve this:<br/><br/>**Configuration Example:**<br/><br/>```nginx<br/>location /prefix/ \{<br/>    rewrite ^/prefix(/.*)$ $1 break;<br/>    proxy_pass http://backend;<br/>    proxy_set_header Host $host;<br/>    proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;<br/>    proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;<br/>\}<br/>```<br/><br/>**Explanation:**<br/><br/>1. **Location Block:** The `location /prefix/` block matches any request that starts with `/prefix/`.<br/><br/>2. **Rewrite Directive:** The `rewrite ^/prefix(/.*)$ $1 break;` line captures the portion of the URI after `/prefix` and rewrites the URI to exclude the `/prefix` segment. The `break` flag ensures that the rewritten URI is used for the subsequent processing within this location block without initiating a new location search.<br/><br/>3. **Proxy Pass:** The `proxy_pass http://backend;` directive forwards the modified request to the backend server. Since no URI is specified in the `proxy_pass` directive, Nginx will pass the rewritten URI as is to the backend.<br/><br/>4. **Header Settings:** The `proxy_set_header` directives ensure that the original request headers are forwarded to the backend server, which can be important for maintaining client information and proper request handling.<br/><br/>**Key Points:**<br/><br/>- **Preserving the Original URI:** By not appending a URI in the `proxy_pass` directive (i.e., no trailing slash after the backend address), Nginx forwards the request URI as modified by the `rewrite` directive without further alterations. This approach ensures that the backend receives the URI exactly as intended.<br/><br/>- **Avoiding Redirects:** The `break` flag in the `rewrite` directive prevents Nginx from performing an internal redirect, which could otherwise lead to unintended behavior or additional processing overhead.<br/><br/>**Additional Considerations:**<br/><br/>- **Regular Expressions in Location Blocks:** If you use a regular expression in the `location` directive, be aware that the behavior of `proxy_pass` may differ. In such cases, it's recommended to specify the `proxy_pass` directive without a URI to ensure the correct forwarding of requests. ([cdn.studio.f5.com](https://cdn.studio.f5.com/files/k6fem79d/production/81ae3260c129870ccc1350ec13f0a5e32d289346.pdf?utm_source=openai))<br/><br/>- **URI Encoding:** Nginx normalizes and decodes URIs when processing requests. To preserve the original encoding, ensure that the `proxy_pass` directive is used without a trailing slash, as this configuration passes the request URI to the backend in its original form. ([joshua.hu](https://joshua.hu/proxy-pass-nginx-decoding-normalizing-url-path-dangerous?utm_source=openai))<br/><br/>By following this configuration, you can set up Nginx to proxy requests, remove a specific prefix from the URI, and preserve the rest of the original URI without causing redirects or unintended modifications. |

**Zusammenfassung:**
- Next.js erhält weiterhin `GET /` statt `GET /audion/`
- Assets funktionieren (`HTTP/2 200` für `/_next/static/...`)
- 308 Redirect bleibt, weil Next.js mit `basePath='/audion'` einen Redirect macht, wenn es `/` statt `/audion/` erhält

**Das Problem:**
Nginx entfernt den `/audion`-Prefix standardmäßig, wenn `location /audion` matched. `proxy_pass http://persona-web$request_uri;` sollte den URI behalten, aber Next.js erhält trotzdem `/`.

**Mögliche Lösungen:**
1. Next.js ohne `basePath` laufen lassen – dann müssen alle internen Links/Assets manuell angepasst werden (kompliziert)
2. Custom Next.js Server – URLs umschreiben (kompliziert, mehr Wartung)
3. Anderen Reverse Proxy verwenden (z.B. Traefik, Caddy) – könnte einfacher sein
4. Next.js auf separatem Port laufen lassen – dann direkter Zugriff ohne Nginx-Routing

Welche Option bevorzugst du? Oder soll ich einen anderen Ansatz testen?

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./PROJECT_DOCUMENTATION.md",
        "range": {

        },
        "contents": "ELEVENLABS_API_KEY=...\nELEVENLABS_VOICE_ID=...\nELEVENLABS_MODEL_ID=eleven_monolingual_v1\nELEVENLABS_BASE_URL=https://api.elevenlabs.io\n\n# Observability (Optional)\nLOGFIRE_TOKEN=...\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Siehe auch:** &#96;knowledge/env.md&#96;\n\n### Lokale Entwicklung\n\n**1. Dependencies installieren:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Frontend\nnpm install\n\n# Backend\ncd apps/api &amp;&amp; uv sync --python 3.12\ncd apps/api &amp;&amp; uv pip install -e ../../packages/proto\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**2. Services starten (Docker Compose):**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncd infrastructure\ndocker compose up -d postgres redis qdrant neo4j tempo\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**3. Datenbank-Migrationen:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncd apps/api\nuv run alembic upgrade head\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**4. Services starten:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Terminal 1: Web\nnpm run dev:web\n\n# Terminal 2: Persona API\ncd apps/api &amp;&amp; uv run fastapi dev app/main.py --port 8000\n\n# Terminal 3: Chat API\ncd apps/chat-api &amp;&amp; uv run fastapi dev app/main.py --port 8001\n\n# Terminal 4: Worker\ncd apps/api &amp;&amp; uv run celery -A app.celery_app worker -Q ingestion -l INFO\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Docker Compose (Vollständig)\n\n**Alle Services starten:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncd infrastructure\ndocker compose up -d\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Services neu bauen:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncd infrastructure\ndocker compose build\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Logs anzeigen:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ndocker compose logs -f [service-name]\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Services stoppen:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ndocker compose down\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Build-Optimierung\n\n**Build Cache konfigurieren:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nexport LOCAL_DOCKER_CACHE_ROOT=/path/to/cache\nmkdir -p $LOCAL_DOCKER_CACHE_ROOT/web $LOCAL_DOCKER_CACHE_ROOT/python\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Build Script verwenden:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nLOCAL_DOCKER_CACHE_ROOT=/path/to/cache ./scripts/build.sh\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Siehe auch:** &#96;knowledge/build-cache.md&#96;\n\n---\n\n## API-Dokumentation\n\n### Persona Backend API (&#96;/api/persona-backend&#96;)\n\n#### Journeys\n\n**GET &#96;/journeys&#96;**\n- Liste aller Journeys mit Pagination\n- Query Params: &#96;target_group_id&#96;, &#96;project_id&#96;, &#96;page&#96;, &#96;page_size&#96;\n- Response: &#96;List[JourneyResponse]&#96;\n\n**POST &#96;/journeys&#96;**\n- Erstelle neue Journey\n- Body: &#96;JourneyCreate&#96;\n- Response: &#96;JourneyResponse&#96;\n\n**GET &#96;/journeys/{journey_id}&#96;**\n- Journey-Details abrufen",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "### Lokale Entwicklung",
            "lineNumber": 385
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 386
          },
          {
            "text": "**1. Dependencies installieren:**",
            "lineNumber": 387
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 388
          },
          {
            "text": "# Frontend",
            "lineNumber": 389
          },
          {
            "text": "npm install",
            "lineNumber": 390
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 391
          },
          {
            "text": "# Backend",
            "lineNumber": 392
          },
          {
            "text": "cd apps/api &amp;&amp; uv sync --python 3.12",
            "lineNumber": 393
          },
          {
            "text": "cd apps/api &amp;&amp; uv pip install -e ../../packages/proto",
            "lineNumber": 394
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 395
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 396
          },
          {
            "text": "**2. Services starten (Docker Compose):**",
            "lineNumber": 397
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 398
          },
          {
            "text": "cd infrastructure",
            "lineNumber": 399
          },
          {
            "text": "docker compose up -d postgres redis qdrant neo4j tempo",
            "lineNumber": 400
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 401
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 402
          },
          {
            "text": "**3. Datenbank-Migrationen:**",
            "lineNumber": 403
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 404
          },
          {
            "text": "cd apps/api",
            "lineNumber": 405
          },
          {
            "text": "uv run alembic upgrade head",
            "lineNumber": 406
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 407
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 408
          },
          {
            "text": "**4. Services starten:**",
            "lineNumber": 409
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 410
          },
          {
            "text": "# Terminal 1: Web",
            "lineNumber": 411
          },
          {
            "text": "npm run dev:web",
            "lineNumber": 412
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 413
          },
          {
            "text": "# Terminal 2: Persona API",
            "lineNumber": 414
          },
          {
            "text": "cd apps/api &amp;&amp; uv run fastapi dev app/main.py --port 8000",
            "lineNumber": 415
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 416
          },
          {
            "text": "# Terminal 3: Chat API",
            "lineNumber": 417
          },
          {
            "text": "cd apps/chat-api &amp;&amp; uv run fastapi dev app/main.py --port 8001",
            "lineNumber": 418
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 419
          },
          {
            "text": "# Terminal 4: Worker",
            "lineNumber": 420
          },
          {
            "text": "cd apps/api &amp;&amp; uv run celery -A app.celery_app worker -Q ingestion -l INFO",
            "lineNumber": 421
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 422
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 423
          },
          {
            "text": "### Docker Compose (Vollständig)",
            "lineNumber": 424
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 425
          },
          {
            "text": "**Alle Services starten:**",
            "lineNumber": 426
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 427
          },
          {
            "text": "cd infrastructure",
            "lineNumber": 428
          },
          {
            "text": "docker compose up -d",
            "lineNumber": 429
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 430
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 431
          },
          {
            "text": "**Services neu bauen:**",
            "lineNumber": 432
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 433
          },
          {
            "text": "cd infrastructure",
            "lineNumber": 434
          },
          {
            "text": "docker compose build",
            "lineNumber": 435
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 436
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 437
          },
          {
            "text": "**Logs anzeigen:**",
            "lineNumber": 438
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 439
          },
          {
            "text": "docker compose logs -f [service-name]",
            "lineNumber": 440
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 441
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 442
          },
          {
            "text": "**Services stoppen:**",
            "lineNumber": 443
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 444
          },
          {
            "text": "docker compose down",
            "lineNumber": 445
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 446
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 447
          },
          {
            "text": "### Build-Optimierung",
            "lineNumber": 448
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 449
          },
          {
            "text": "**Build Cache konfigurieren:**",
            "lineNumber": 450
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 451
          },
          {
            "text": "export LOCAL_DOCKER_CACHE_ROOT=/path/to/cache",
            "lineNumber": 452
          },
          {
            "text": "mkdir -p $LOCAL_DOCKER_CACHE_ROOT/web $LOCAL_DOCKER_CACHE_ROOT/python",
            "lineNumber": 453
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 454
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 455
          },
          {
            "text": "**Build Script verwenden:**",
            "lineNumber": 456
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 457
          },
          {
            "text": "LOCAL_DOCKER_CACHE_ROOT=/path/to/cache ./scripts/build.sh",
            "lineNumber": 458
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 459
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 460
          },
          {
            "text": "**Siehe auch:** &#96;knowledge/build-cache.md&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 461
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 462
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 463
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 464
          },
          {
            "text": "## API-Dokumentation",
            "lineNumber": 465
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 466
          },
          {
            "text": "### Persona Backend API (&#96;/api/persona-backend&#96;)",
            "lineNumber": 467
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 468
          },
          {
            "text": "#### Journeys",
            "lineNumber": 469
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 470
          },
          {
            "text": "**GET &#96;/journeys&#96;**",
            "lineNumber": 471
          },
          {
            "text": "- Liste aller Journeys mit Pagination",
            "lineNumber": 472
          },
          {
            "text": "- Query Params: &#96;target_group_id&#96;, &#96;project_id&#96;, &#96;page&#96;, &#96;page_size&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 473
          },
          {
            "text": "- Response: &#96;List[JourneyResponse]&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 474
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 475
          },
          {
            "text": "**POST &#96;/journeys&#96;**",
            "lineNumber": 476
          },
          {
            "text": "- Erstelle neue Journey",
            "lineNumber": 477
          },
          {
            "text": "- Body: &#96;JourneyCreate&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 478
          },
          {
            "text": "- Response: &#96;JourneyResponse&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 479
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 480
          },
          {
            "text": "**GET &#96;/journeys/{journey_id}&#96;**",
            "lineNumber": 481
          },
          {
            "text": "- Journey-Details abrufen",
            "lineNumber": 482
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.4308839440345764

        "contents": "# Coolify Deployment Guide - Persona Chat Projekt\n\n## Übersicht\n\nDieses Dokument beschreibt alle Aspekte, die beim Deployment des Persona Chat Projekts auf Coolify beachtet werden müssen.\n\n## Architektur-Übersicht\n\nDas Projekt besteht aus:\n- **3 Python FastAPI Services**: persona-api, chat-api, indexing-api\n- **1 Next.js Frontend**: web\n- **2 Celery Workers**: persona-worker, indexing-worker\n- **5 Datenbanken/Services**: PostgreSQL, Redis, Qdrant, Neo4j, Tempo\n- **1 Reverse Proxy**: Nginx (wird durch Coolify's Traefik ersetzt)\n\n---\n\n## Kritische Unterschiede zu Docker Compose\n\n### 1. Kein Docker Compose Support\n\n**Problem:** Coolify deployt keine Docker Compose Stacks direkt. Jeder Service muss als separate \"Application\" in Coolify konfiguriert werden.\n\n**Lösung:**\n- Jeder Service (web, persona-api, chat-api, indexing-api, persona-worker, indexing-worker) wird eine eigene Coolify-App\n- Datenbanken können als Coolify's \"Services\" (PostgreSQL, Redis) oder als separate Apps deployt werden\n- Qdrant, Neo4j und Tempo müssen als separate Docker-Apps konfiguriert werden\n\n### 2. Service Discovery\n\n**Problem:** Docker Compose verwendet Service-Namen (z.B. &#96;postgres:5432&#96;), Coolify nutzt interne URLs.\n\n**Lösung:**\n- Coolify generiert interne URLs für jeden Service\n- Environment Variables müssen dynamisch auf Coolify's interne URLs verweisen\n- Beispiel: Statt &#96;postgres:5432&#96; → &#96;coolify-internal-{postgres-app-id}:5432&#96;\n\n### 3. Reverse Proxy (Traefik statt Nginx)\n\n**Problem:** Aktuell wird Nginx als Reverse Proxy verwendet. Coolify nutzt Traefik.\n\n**Lösung:**\n- Traefik ist bereits in Coolify integriert\n- Routing wird über Coolify's UI konfiguriert\n- Nginx-Container wird nicht benötigt\n- Path-basiertes Routing (&#96;/api/chat&#96;, &#96;/api/persona-backend&#96;) über Traefik Labels\n\n### 4. Volumes und Persistent Storage\n\n**Problem:** Docker Compose Volumes müssen zu Coolify Persistent Volumes migriert werden.\n\n**Lösung:**\n- Datenbank-Daten: Coolify's PostgreSQL/Redis Services haben automatische Persistence\n- Qdrant, Neo4j: Separate Volume-Configs in Coolify",

        "contents": "### 3. Qdrant (Separate App)\n\n**Docker Image:** &#96;qdrant/qdrant:v1.11.3&#96;\n\n**Environment Variables:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nQDRANT__SERVICE__HTTP_PORT=6333\nQDRANT__SERVICE__GRPC_PORT=6334\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Persistent Volume:**\n- Path: &#96;/qdrant/storage&#96;\n- Coolify Persistent Storage\n\n**Public URL:** &#96;http://qdrant.{domain}/&#96; (über Traefik)\n\n### 4. Neo4j (Separate App)\n\n**Docker Image:** &#96;neo4j:5.22.0&#96;\n\n**Environment Variables:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nNEO4J_AUTH=neo4j/{NEO4J_PASSWORD}\nNEO4J_PLUGINS=[\"apoc\"]\nNEO4J_dbms_security_procedures_unrestricted=apoc.*\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Persistent Volume:**\n- Path: &#96;/data&#96;\n- Coolify Persistent Storage\n\n**Ports:**\n- HTTP: 7474\n- Bolt: 7687\n\n### 5. Tempo (Optional, Observability)\n\n**Docker Image:** &#96;grafana/tempo:2.6.0&#96;\n\n**Config File:** Via Volume Mount oder ConfigMap\n**Port:** 4318 (OTLP)\n\n---\n\n## Application Konfigurationen\n\n### 1. persona-web (Next.js Frontend)\n\n**Build Configuration:**\n- **Buildpack:** Dockerfile\n- **Dockerfile:** &#96;apps/web/Dockerfile&#96;\n- **Build Context:** Repository Root\n- **Build Args:**\n  - &#96;NODE_IMAGE=node:22.11.0-alpine&#96;\n  - &#96;RUN_WEB_BUILD=true&#96;\n\n**Environment Variables:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Public URLs (Coolify generiert automatisch)\nNEXT_PUBLIC_INDEXING_API_URL=https://indexing-api.{domain}/api/indexing\nNEXT_PUBLIC_CHAT_API_URL=https://chat-api.{domain}/api/chat\nNEXT_PUBLIC_WS_BASE_URL=wss://chat-api.{domain}/api/chat\nNEXT_PUBLIC_PERSONA_BACKEND_URL=https://persona-api.{domain}/api/persona-backend\nNEXT_PUBLIC_PERSONA_BACKEND_DOCS_URL=https://persona-api.{domain}/api/persona-backend/docs\n\n# Internal URLs (für Server-Side Requests)\nNEXT_BACKEND_INTERNAL_URL=http://coolify-internal-indexing-api:8000\nNEXT_CHAT_API_INTERNAL_URL=http://coolify-internal-chat-api:8001\nNEXT_PERSONA_BACKEND_INTERNAL_URL=http://coolify-internal-persona-api:8000\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Port:** 3000\n**Health Check:** &#96;GET /&#96;\n\n**Traefik Labels (via Coolify UI):**\n- Domain: &#96;persona-chat.{domain}&#96;\n- Path: &#96;/&#96;\n\n### 2. persona-api (FastAPI Backend)\n\n**Build Configuration:**\n- **Buildpack:** Dockerfile\n- **Dockerfile:** &#96;apps/api/Dockerfile&#96;\n- **Build Context:** Repository Root\n\n**Environment Variables:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",

        "contents": "**Hinweis:** Audion läuft unter dem Pfad &#96;/audion&#96;, um parallelen Betrieb mit anderen Services (z.B. &#96;/dashboard&#96;) zu ermöglichen.\n\n| Service | Public URL | Internal URL | Beschreibung |\n|---------|-----------|--------------|--------------|\n| Web App | &#96;https://192.168.50.101/audion/&#96; | &#96;http://web:3000&#96; | Next.js Frontend |\n| Chat API | &#96;https://192.168.50.101/audion/api/chat&#96; | &#96;http://chat-api:8001&#96; | Real-time Chat Service |\n| Voice API | &#96;https://192.168.50.101/audion/api/voice&#96; | &#96;http://chat-api:8001&#96; | Voice Streaming |\n| Persona Backend | &#96;https://192.168.50.101/audion/api/persona-backend&#96; | &#96;http://persona-api:8000&#96; | Persona Management API |\n| Persona Docs | &#96;https://192.168.50.101/audion/api/persona-backend/docs&#96; | - | FastAPI Swagger UI |\n| Indexing API | &#96;https://192.168.50.101/audion/api/indexing&#96; | &#96;http://indexing-api:8000&#96; | Document Ingestion |\n| Neo4j Browser | &#96;https://192.168.50.101/neo4j/browser&#96; | &#96;http://neo4j:7474&#96; | Neo4j Web UI (global) |\n| Qdrant Dashboard | &#96;https://192.168.50.101/qdrant/&#96; | &#96;http://qdrant:6333&#96; | Qdrant Web UI (global) |\n\n### Development URLs (Local)\n\n| Service | URL | Port |\n|---------|-----|------|\n| Web App | &#96;http://localhost:3000&#96;         "contents": "# Audion Base Path Konfiguration\n\n## Übersicht\n\nAudion wurde so konfiguriert, dass es unter dem Pfad &#96;/audion&#96; läuft, um parallelen Betrieb mit anderen Services auf derselben Maschine zu ermöglichen (z.B. ein anderer Service unter &#96;/dashboard&#96;).\n\n## Konfiguration\n\n### Nginx (&#96;infrastructure/nginx/nginx.conf&#96;)\n\nAlle Audion-Routen wurden von &#96;/&#96; auf &#96;/audion&#96; verschoben:\n\n- **Web App**: &#96;/audion/&#96; → &#96;http://web:3000&#96;\n- **Chat API**: &#96;/audion/api/chat&#96; → &#96;http://chat-api:8001&#96;\n- **Voice API**: &#96;/audion/api/voice&#96; → &#96;http://chat-api:8001&#96;\n- **Persona Backend**: &#96;/audion/api/persona-backend&#96; → &#96;http://persona-api:8000&#96;\n- **Indexing API**: &#96;/audion/api/indexing&#96; → &#96;http://indexing-api:8000&#96;\n\n**Wichtig**: Neo4j und Qdrant bleiben global unter &#96;/neo4j/&#96; und &#96;/qdrant/&#96; erreichbar.\n\n### Next.js (&#96;apps/web/next.config.mjs&#96;)\n\nDer &#96;basePath&#96; wurde hinzugefügt:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\nbasePath: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH || '/audion'\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nDies stellt sicher, dass Next.js alle internen Routen und Assets korrekt unter &#96;/audion&#96; serviert.\n\n### Docker Compose (&#96;infrastructure/compose.yml&#96;)\n\nAlle öffentlichen URLs wurden aktualisiert:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;yaml\nenvironment:\n  NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH: /audion\n  NEXT_PUBLIC_INDEXING_API_URL: https://192.168.50.101/audion/api/indexing\n  NEXT_PUBLIC_CHAT_API_URL: https://192.168.50.101/audion/api/chat\n  NEXT_PUBLIC_WS_BASE_URL: wss://192.168.50.101/audion/api/chat\n  NEXT_PUBLIC_PERSONA_BACKEND_URL: https://192.168.50.101/audion/api/persona-backend\n  NEXT_PUBLIC_PERSONA_BACKEND_DOCS_URL: https://192.168.50.101/audion/api/persona-backend/docs\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## URLs nach Migration\n\n### Audion Services\n- **Web App**: &#96;https://192.168.50.101/audion/&#96;\n- **Chat API**: &#96;https://192.168.50.101/audion/api/chat&#96;\n- **Voice API**: &#96;https://192.168.50.101/audion/api/voice&#96;\n- **Persona Backend**: &#96;https://192.168.50.101/audion/api/persona-backend&#96;\n- **Persona Docs**: &#96;https://192.168.50.101/audion/api/persona-backend/docs&#96;\n- **Indexing API**: &#96;https://192.168.50.101/audion/api/indexing&#96;",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "- Klare Commit-Messages\n- Tests für neue Features\n- Dokumentation aktualisieren\n\n---\n\n## Deployment\n\n### Deployment-Optionen\n\n**Aktuell:** Docker Compose auf eigenem Server\n**Alternative:** Coolify (siehe &#96;knowledge/coolify-deployment.md&#96; für vollständigen Guide)\n\n### Production Server\n\n**Server:** &#96;192.168.50.101&#96;\n\n### Deployment-Prozess\n\n**1. Code aktualisieren:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nssh user@192.168.50.101\ncd /path/to/AUDION\ngit pull origin main\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**2. Services neu bauen:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncd infrastructure\nWEB_RUN_BUILD=true docker compose build web\ndocker compose build persona-api chat-api indexing-api\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**3. Services neu starten:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ndocker compose up -d\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**4. Logs prüfen:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ndocker compose logs -f [service-name]\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Nginx Konfiguration\n\n**Config:** &#96;infrastructure/nginx/nginx.conf&#96;\n\n**Features:**\n- HTTPS (Port 443)\n- HTTP → HTTPS Redirect\n- Reverse Proxy für alle Services\n- WebSocket Support für Chat\n- SSL Certificates in &#96;infrastructure/nginx/ssl/&#96;\n\n### Datenbank-Migrationen\n\n**Auf Production:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncd apps/api\nuv run alembic upgrade head\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Oder via Docker:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ndocker compose exec persona-api uv run alembic upgrade head\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Backup-Strategie\n\n**PostgreSQL:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ndocker compose exec postgres pg_dump -U persona persona &gt; backup.sql\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Qdrant:**\n- Volumes werden in &#96;qdrant-data&#96; gespeichert\n- Backup: Volume kopieren\n\n**Neo4j:**\n- Volumes werden in &#96;neo4j-data&#96; gespeichert\n- Backup: Volume kopieren\n\n### Monitoring\n\n**Service Status:**\n- Endpoint: &#96;GET /api/persona-backend/queue/services/status&#96;\n- Prüft: PostgreSQL, Redis, Qdrant, Neo4j, Celery Workers\n\n**Logs:**\n- Docker Compose Logs: &#96;docker compose logs -f&#96;\n- OpenTelemetry: Tempo (Port 4318)\n- Logfire: Strukturierte Logs (optional)\n\n---\n\n## Testing\n\n### Frontend Tests\n\n**Unit Tests:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm test --workspaces\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Type Checking:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm run typecheck:web\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Linting:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm run lint:web\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Backend Tests\n\n**Unit Tests:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncd apps/api\nuv run pytest tests/\n&#96;&#96;&#96;",
        "signatures": {},

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 954
          },
          {
            "text": "## Deployment",
            "lineNumber": 955
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 956
          },
          {
            "text": "### Deployment-Optionen",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 958
          },
          {
            "text": "**Aktuell:** Docker Compose auf eigenem Server",
            "lineNumber": 959
          },
          {
            "text": "**Alternative:** Coolify (siehe &#96;knowledge/coolify-deployment.md&#96; für vollständigen Guide)",
            "lineNumber": 960
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 961
          },
          {
            "text": "### Production Server",
            "lineNumber": 962
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 963
          },
          {
            "text": "**Server:** &#96;192.168.50.101&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 964
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 965
          },
          {
            "text": "### Deployment-Prozess",
            "lineNumber": 966
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 967
          },
          {
            "text": "**1. Code aktualisieren:**",
            "lineNumber": 968
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 969
          },
          {
            "text": "ssh user@192.168.50.101",

          },
          {
            "text": "cd /path/to/AUDION",
            "lineNumber": 971
          },
          {
            "text": "git pull origin main",

          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 973
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 974
          },
          {
            "text": "**2. Services neu bauen:**",
            "lineNumber": 975
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 976
          },
          {
            "text": "cd infrastructure",
            "lineNumber": 977
          },
          {
            "text": "WEB_RUN_BUILD=true docker compose build web",
            "lineNumber": 978
          },
          {
            "text": "docker compose build persona-api chat-api indexing-api",
            "lineNumber": 979
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 980
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 981
          },
          {
            "text": "**3. Services neu starten:**",
            "lineNumber": 982
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 983
          },
          {
            "text": "docker compose up -d",
            "lineNumber": 984
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 985
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 986
          },
          {
            "text": "**4. Logs prüfen:**",
            "lineNumber": 987
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 988
          },
          {
            "text": "docker compose logs -f [service-name]",
            "lineNumber": 989
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 990
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 991
          },
          {
            "text": "### Nginx Konfiguration",

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 995
          },
          {
            "text": "**Features:**",

          },

          },
          {

          },

          },
          {

          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 1003
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1004
          },
          {
            "text": "**Auf Production:**",

          },

          },

          },

          },

            "lineNumber": 1014
          },
          {

          },

          {

            "lineNumber": 1019
          },
          {

          },

            "lineNumber": 1021
          },
          {

          },

          {

          },

          },
          {

          },

        "contents": "**Technologien:**\n- FastAPI\n- SQLAlchemy\n- Celery\n- Pydantic\n\n**Hauptfunktionen:**\n- Persona CRUD Operations\n- Target Groups Management\n- Document Management\n- Knowledge Entries Management\n- Queue Management\n- Service Status Monitoring\n\n**Commands:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncd apps/api\nuv sync                    # Dependencies installieren\nuv run fastapi dev app/main.py --port 8000  # Development Server\nuv run celery -A app.celery_app worker -Q ingestion -l INFO  # Worker\nuv run pytest              # Tests\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 3. Chat API (Real-time Chat Service)\n\n**Pfad:** &#96;apps/chat-api/&#96;\n\n**Technologien:**\n- FastAPI\n- WebSocket\n- Anthropic Claude API\n- Vector Retrieval\n\n**Hauptfunktionen:**\n- Real-time Chat (WebSocket)\n- Persona Discovery\n- Persona Generation\n- Voice Streaming\n- Retrieval Agent Integration\n\n**Commands:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncd apps/chat-api\nuv sync\nuv run fastapi dev app/main.py --port 8001\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 4. Indexing API (Document Processing)\n\n**Pfad:** &#96;apps/indexing-api/&#96;\n\n**Technologien:**\n- FastAPI\n- Unstructured\n- FlagEmbedding (BGE-M3)\n- faster-whisper\n\n**Hauptfunktionen:**\n- Document Upload &amp; Processing\n- Text Extraction\n- Audio Transkription\n- Chunking &amp; Embedding\n- Qdrant Integration\n\n**Commands:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncd apps/indexing-api\nuv sync\nuv run fastapi dev app/main.py --port 8000\nuv run celery -A app.workers.process worker -Q indexing -l info\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 5. Workers (Celery)\n\n**Persona Worker:**\n- Queue: &#96;ingestion&#96;\n- Tasks: Document Ingestion, Persona Generation\n\n**Indexing Worker:**\n- Queue: &#96;indexing&#96;\n- Tasks: Document Processing, Embedding Generation\n\n---\n\n## Setup und Installation\n\n### Voraussetzungen\n\n- Docker &amp; Docker Compose\n- Node.js 22+ (für lokale Web-Entwicklung)\n- Python 3.12+ (für lokale Backend-Entwicklung)\n- uv (Python Package Manager)\n\n### Environment-Variablen\n\n**Root &#96;.env&#96; Datei erstellen:**\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# AI APIs\nANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-api03-...\nCLAUDE_API_KEY=${ANTHROPIC_API_KEY}  # Alias\nOPENAI_API_KEY=sk-...  # Für Persona Image Generation\n\n# Voice (Optional)\nELEVENLABS_API_KEY=...\nELEVENLABS_VOICE_ID=...",

          },
          {

        "contents": "events {\n    worker_connections 1024;\n}\n\nhttp {\n    resolver 127.0.0.11 valid=30s;\n\n    upstream web {\n        zone web 64k;\n        # Container-Name kann variieren, daher verwenden wir den Service-Namen aus docker-compose\n        # Der tatsächliche Container-Name wird zur Laufzeit aufgelöst\n        server persona-web:3000 resolve;\n    }\n\n    upstream chat-api {\n        zone chat_api 64k;\n        server persona-chat-api:8001 resolve;\n    }\n\n    upstream indexing-api {\n        zone indexing_api 64k;\n        server persona-indexing-api:8000 resolve;\n    }\n\n    upstream persona-api {\n        zone persona_api 64k;\n        server persona-backend-api:8000 resolve;\n    }\n\n    # HTTP to HTTPS redirect\n    server {\n        listen 80;\n        server_name 192.168.50.101;\n        return 301 https://$server_name$request_uri;\n    }\n\n    # HTTPS server\n    server {\n        listen 443 ssl;",

        "contents": "### 4. indexing-api (FastAPI Indexing Service)\n\n**Build Configuration:**\n- **Buildpack:** Dockerfile\n- **Dockerfile:** &#96;apps/indexing-api/Dockerfile&#96;\n- **Build Context:** Repository Root\n\n**Environment Variables:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nAPP_ENV=production\nAPI_HOST=0.0.0.0\nAPI_PORT=8000\n\nDATA_DIR=/app/data/uploads\n\nDATABASE_URL=postgresql+psycopg://persona:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}@coolify-postgres:5432/persona\nREDIS_URL=redis://:${REDIS_PASSWORD}@coolify-redis:6379/0\nQDRANT_URL=http://coolify-internal-qdrant:6333\n\nOTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=http://coolify-internal-tempo:4318\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Port:** 8000\n**Health Check:** &#96;GET /health&#96;\n\n**Persistent Volumes:**\n- &#96;/app/data/uploads&#96; → Shared Storage\n- &#96;/root/.cache/huggingface&#96; → Shared HuggingFace Cache\n\n**Traefik Labels:**\n- Path: &#96;/api/indexing&#96;\n- Strip Prefix: &#96;/api/indexing&#96;\n\n### 5. persona-worker (Celery Worker)\n\n**Build Configuration:**\n- **Dockerfile:** &#96;apps/api/Dockerfile&#96; (gleiche wie persona-api)\n- **Command Override:**\n  &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n  celery -A app.celery_app worker -Q ingestion -l info --pool=threads --concurrency=2\n  &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Environment Variables:**\n- Gleiche wie persona-api\n- Kein Port (Worker läuft im Hintergrund)\n\n**Persistent Volumes:**\n- &#96;/app/data/uploads&#96; → Shared Storage\n- &#96;/root/.cache/huggingface&#96; → Shared HuggingFace Cache\n\n### 6. indexing-worker (Celery Worker)\n\n**Build Configuration:**\n- **Dockerfile:** &#96;apps/indexing-api/Dockerfile&#96; (gleiche wie indexing-api)\n- **Command Override:**\n  &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n  celery -A app.workers.process worker -Q indexing -l info --pool=threads --concurrency=2\n  &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Environment Variables:**\n- Gleiche wie indexing-api\n\n**Persistent Volumes:**\n- &#96;/app/data/uploads&#96; → Shared Storage\n- &#96;/root/.cache/huggingface&#96; → Shared HuggingFace Cache\n\n---\n\n## Environment Variables Management\n\n### Coolify Secrets\n\nAlle sensiblen Werte über Coolify Secrets:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Database\nPOSTGRES_PASSWORD=&lt;secure-password&gt;\nREDIS_PASSWORD=&lt;secure-password&gt;\nNEO4J_PASSWORD=&lt;secure-password&gt;\n\n# AI APIs\nANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-api03-...\nELEVENLABS_API_KEY=...\nELEVENLABS_VOICE_ID=...\nOPENAI_API_KEY=sk-...",

            "lineNumber": 336
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 337
          },
          {
            "text": "**Build Configuration:**",
            "lineNumber": 338
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Dockerfile:** &#96;apps/api/Dockerfile&#96; (gleiche wie persona-api)",

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "  &#96;&#96;&#96;bash",

          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 343
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 344
          },

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },

          },
          {

          },

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },

        "contents": "# Backend Persona Workspace (2025-11-20)\n\n## Runtime Topology\n- &#96;apps/api&#96; (FastAPI 0.121.3, verified via &#96;curl https://pypi.org/pypi/fastapi/json&#96;) exposes REST + WS for persona management at &#96;http://0.0.0.0:8000&#96;.\n- Companion services from &#96;infrastructure/compose.yml&#96;:\n  - PostgreSQL 17 → &#96;postgresql://persona:persona@localhost:55432/persona&#96;.\n  - Redis 7 (cache/jobs) → &#96;redis://localhost:6380/0&#96;.\n  - Qdrant v1.11.3 → &#96;http://localhost:6333&#96;.\n  - Neo4j 5.22 (bolt &#96;bolt://localhost:7687&#96;, http &#96;http://localhost:7474&#96;).\n  - MinIO (S3-compatible object store) exposed on &#96;http://localhost:9000&#96; (console &#96;http://localhost:9001&#96;) with bucket &#96;persona-research&#96; for persona documents/avatars.\n  - Tempo OTLP collector → &#96;http://localhost:4318&#96;.\n  - Web frontend Next.js → &#96;http://localhost:3000&#96; (internal APIs via &#96;NEXT_*_INTERNAL_URL&#96; routing through nginx proxy &#96;https://192.168.50.101&#96; per compose).\n\n## Code Entry Points\n- FastAPI startup &#96;apps/api/app/main.py&#96; wires routers &#96;documents&#96;, &#96;personas&#96;, and WS &#96;chat&#96;.\n- Database models defined in &#96;apps/api/app/models/__init__.py&#96;; persona tables now include metadata (status, locks, avatar URL) plus &#96;persona_knowledge_entries&#96; for appended knowledge.\n- Settings come from &#96;apps/api/app/core/config.py&#96; (Pydantic settings pulling &#96;.env&#96;, including &#96;database_url&#96;, &#96;redis_url&#96;, &#96;qdrant_url&#96;, &#96;neo4j_uri&#96;, &#96;neo4j_browser_url&#96;, etc.) → prefer referencing these env keys instead of hardcoding endpoints.\n\n## Data Flow (Persona Read/Update)\n1. REST request hits FastAPI router (&#96;app/routers/personas.py&#96;) and is delegated to &#96;PersonaService&#96;.\n2. &#96;PersonaService&#96; loads SQLAlchemy models plus latest prompt + sources, hydrates Pydantic schemas, and memoizes via Redis cache (cache-aside, TTL configurable).\n3. Insights builder consults Qdrant + Neo4j (best-effort) to enrich persona detail responses; fallbacks keep API resilient when downstreams degrade.\n4. Mutations (create/update/archive) persist audit rows, emit structlog events (&#96;persona.create|update|archive&#96;), invalidate Redis cache, and allow future hooks (Celery, WS streaming) to subscribe.\n\n- &#96;GET /personas&#96; – Pagination/filter (project, status, query) returning &#96;PersonaListResponse&#96;.",

([utupub.fi](https://www.utupub.fi/bitstream/10024/194200/1/Master_Thesis_Resnais_Evenn.pdf?utm_source=openai))<br/><br/>- **Subpath Routing:** Traefik supports subpath routing through the use of labels in Docker Compose. For instance, you can define a router with a rule that matches a specific path prefix and then apply a middleware to strip that prefix before forwarding the request to the appropriate service. ([dbodky.me](https://dbodky.me/blog/how-to-reverse-proxy-applications-on-subpaths-with-traefik/?utm_source=openai))<br/><br/>- **Middleware Support:** Traefik offers a variety of middlewares, such as `StripPrefix`, which can be used to modify requests before they reach your services. This is useful for handling subpath routing scenarios. This can be advantageous for small to medium-sized projects where ease of use is a priority. ([drcodes.com](https://drcodes.com/posts/nginx-vs-caddy-vs-traefik-best-reverse-proxy-for-microservices-2025?utm_source=openai))<br/><br/>- **Subpath Routing:** Caddy handles subpath routing using directives like `handle_path`. This allows you to define specific routes and the corresponding backends directly within the Caddyfile. ([drcodes.com](https://drcodes.com/posts/nginx-vs-caddy-vs-traefik-best-reverse-proxy-for-microservices-2025?utm_source=openai))<br/><br/>**Considerations:**<br/><br/>- **Performance:** Both Traefik and Caddy offer competitive performance. Traefik is optimized for dynamic routing and service discovery, while Caddy focuses on simplicity and developer experience. ([drcodes.com](https://drcodes.com/posts/nginx-vs-caddy-vs-traefik-best-reverse-proxy-for-microservices-2025?utm_source=openai))<br/><br/>- **Community and Support:** Traefik has a larger community and is widely adopted in cloud-native environments, which can be beneficial for troubleshooting and support.<br/><br/>- **Use Case Suitability:** If your environment involves frequent changes and dynamic service discovery, Traefik's capabilities may be more aligned with your needs. Conversely, if you prefer a simpler setup with automatic HTTPS and straightforward configuration, Caddy could be more appropriate.<br/><br/>In summary, both Traefik and Caddy are capable of handling subpath routing in a Docker Compose setup. **Es funktioniert.**

Die Audion-Seite wird korrekt angezeigt:
- Titel: "Audion"
- Beschreibung: "Upload your raw research, let AI discover personas live..."
- Links zu `/audion/upload` und `/audion/chat`
- Assets werden korrekt mit `/audion/_next/static/...` geladen

**Zusammenfassung:**

1. Traefik als zentraler Reverse Proxy eingerichtet
2. Echon-Services mit Traefik-Labels konfiguriert
3. Audion-Services mit Traefik-Labels konfiguriert (ohne StripPrefix, da Next.js `basePath='/audion'` den Prefix erwartet)
4. Nginx in beiden Projekten deaktiviert
5. Traefik-Konfiguration getestet und validiert

**Wichtige Erkenntnis:** Bei Next.js mit `basePath='/audion'` darf der `/audion`-Prefix nicht entfernt werden. Traefik leitet die Anfrage mit dem Prefix weiter, und Next.js verarbeitet sie korrekt.

**Nächste Schritte:**
- Echon-Services testen (sollten unter `/` laufen)
- API-Endpunkte testen
- Dokumentation aktualisieren

Soll ich Echon testen oder etwas anderes prüfen?

        "contents": "# Audion Base Path Konfiguration\n\n## Übersicht\n\nAudion wurde so konfiguriert, dass es unter dem Pfad &#96;/audion&#96; läuft, um parallelen Betrieb mit anderen Services auf derselben Maschine zu ermöglichen (z.B. ein anderer Service unter &#96;/dashboard&#96;).\n\n## Konfiguration\n\n### Nginx (&#96;infrastructure/nginx/nginx.conf&#96;)\n\nAlle Audion-Routen wurden von &#96;/&#96; auf &#96;/audion&#96; verschoben:\n\n- **Web App**: &#96;/audion/&#96; → &#96;http://web:3000&#96;\n- **Chat API**: &#96;/audion/api/chat&#96; → &#96;http://chat-api:8001&#96;\n- **Voice API**: &#96;/audion/api/voice&#96; → &#96;http://chat-api:8001&#96;\n- **Persona Backend**: &#96;/audion/api/persona-backend&#96; → &#96;http://persona-api:8000&#96;\n- **Indexing API**: &#96;/audion/api/indexing&#96; → &#96;http://indexing-api:8000&#96;\n\n**Wichtig**: Neo4j und Qdrant bleiben global unter &#96;/neo4j/&#96; und &#96;/qdrant/&#96; erreichbar.\n\n### Next.js (&#96;apps/web/next.config.mjs&#96;)\n\nDer &#96;basePath&#96; wurde hinzugefügt:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\nbasePath: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH || '/audion'\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nDies stellt sicher, dass Next.js alle internen Routen und Assets korrekt unter &#96;/audion&#96; serviert.\n\n### Docker Compose (&#96;infrastructure/compose.yml&#96;)\n\nAlle öffentlichen URLs wurden aktualisiert:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;yaml\nenvironment:\n  NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH: /audion\n  NEXT_PUBLIC_INDEXING_API_URL: https://192.168.50.101/audion/api/indexing\n  NEXT_PUBLIC_CHAT_API_URL: https://192.168.50.101/audion/api/chat\n  NEXT_PUBLIC_WS_BASE_URL: wss://192.168.50.101/audion/api/chat\n  NEXT_PUBLIC_PERSONA_BACKEND_URL: https://192.168.50.101/audion/api/persona-backend\n  NEXT_PUBLIC_PERSONA_BACKEND_DOCS_URL: https://192.168.50.101/audion/api/persona-backend/docs\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## URLs nach Migration\n\n### Audion Services\n- **Web App**: &#96;https://192.168.50.101/audion/&#96;\n- **Chat API**: &#96;https://192.168.50.101/audion/api/chat&#96;\n- **Voice API**: &#96;https://192.168.50.101/audion/api/voice&#96;\n- **Persona Backend**: &#96;https://192.168.50.101/audion/api/persona-backend&#96;\n- **Persona Docs**: &#96;https://192.168.50.101/audion/api/persona-backend/docs&#96;\n- **Indexing API**: &#96;https://192.168.50.101/audion/api/indexing&#96;",

            "text": "## Übersicht",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "Audion wurde so konfiguriert, dass es unter dem Pfad &#96;/audion&#96; läuft, um parallelen Betrieb mit anderen Services auf derselben Maschine zu ermöglichen (z.B. ein anderer Service unter &#96;/dashboard&#96;).",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "## Konfiguration",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "### Nginx (&#96;infrastructure/nginx/nginx.conf&#96;)",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "Alle Audion-Routen wurden von &#96;/&#96; auf &#96;/audion&#96; verschoben:",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Web App**: &#96;/audion/&#96; → &#96;http://web:3000&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Chat API**: &#96;/audion/api/chat&#96; → &#96;http://chat-api:8001&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Voice API**: &#96;/audion/api/voice&#96; → &#96;http://chat-api:8001&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Persona Backend**: &#96;/audion/api/persona-backend&#96; → &#96;http://persona-api:8000&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Indexing API**: &#96;/audion/api/indexing&#96; → &#96;http://indexing-api:8000&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "**Wichtig**: Neo4j und Qdrant bleiben global unter &#96;/neo4j/&#96; und &#96;/qdrant/&#96; erreichbar.",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "### Next.js (&#96;apps/web/next.config.mjs&#96;)",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "Der &#96;basePath&#96; wurde hinzugefügt:",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "basePath: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH || '/audion'",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "Dies stellt sicher, dass Next.js alle internen Routen und Assets korrekt unter &#96;/audion&#96; serviert.",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "### Docker Compose (&#96;infrastructure/compose.yml&#96;)",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "Alle öffentlichen URLs wurden aktualisiert:",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;yaml",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "environment:",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "  NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH: /audion",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "  NEXT_PUBLIC_INDEXING_API_URL: https://192.168.50.101/audion/api/indexing",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "  NEXT_PUBLIC_CHAT_API_URL: https://192.168.50.101/audion/api/chat",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "  NEXT_PUBLIC_WS_BASE_URL: wss://192.168.50.101/audion/api/chat",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "  NEXT_PUBLIC_PERSONA_BACKEND_URL: https://192.168.50.101/audion/api/persona-backend",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "  NEXT_PUBLIC_PERSONA_BACKEND_DOCS_URL: https://192.168.50.101/audion/api/persona-backend/docs",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "## URLs nach Migration",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "### Audion Services",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Web App**: &#96;https://192.168.50.101/audion/&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Chat API**: &#96;https://192.168.50.101/audion/api/chat&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Voice API**: &#96;https://192.168.50.101/audion/api/voice&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Persona Backend**: &#96;https://192.168.50.101/audion/api/persona-backend&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Persona Docs**: &#96;https://192.168.50.101/audion/api/persona-backend/docs&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Indexing API**: &#96;https://192.168.50.101/audion/api/indexing&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 53
          }
        ]
      },

        "contents": "    }\n\n    # HTTPS server\n    server {\n        listen 443 ssl;\n        http2 on;\n        server_name 192.168.50.101;\n        client_max_body_size 200m;\n\n        ssl_certificate /etc/nginx/ssl/cert.pem;\n        ssl_certificate_key /etc/nginx/ssl/key.pem;\n        ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;\n        ssl_ciphers HIGH:!aNULL:!MD5;\n\n        # Audion Web application - unter /audion\n        # Wichtig: /audion/ muss vor /audion kommen (spezifischere Route zuerst)\n        location /audion/ {\n            # Remove /audion prefix before passing to Next.js\n            rewrite ^/audion(.*)$ $1 break;\n            proxy_pass http://web;\n            proxy_http_version 1.1;\n            proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;\n            proxy_set_header Connection 'upgrade';\n            proxy_set_header Host $host;\n            proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;\n            proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;\n            proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;\n            proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Prefix /audion;\n            proxy_cache_bypass $http_upgrade;\n        }\n\n        # Redirect /audion to /audion/ (trailing slash handling)\n        location = /audion {\n            return 301 /audion/;\n        }\n\n        # Chat API - unter /audion/api/chat\n        location /audion/api/chat {\n            rewrite ^/audion/api/chat(.*)$ /chat$1 break;",

        "contents": "### 3. Qdrant (Separate App)\n\n**Docker Image:** &#96;qdrant/qdrant:v1.11.3&#96;\n\n**Environment Variables:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nQDRANT__SERVICE__HTTP_PORT=6333\nQDRANT__SERVICE__GRPC_PORT=6334\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Persistent Volume:**\n- Path: &#96;/qdrant/storage&#96;\n- Coolify Persistent Storage\n\n**Public URL:** &#96;http://qdrant.{domain}/&#96; (über Traefik)\n\n### 4. Neo4j (Separate App)\n\n**Docker Image:** &#96;neo4j:5.22.0&#96;\n\n**Environment Variables:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nNEO4J_AUTH=neo4j/{NEO4J_PASSWORD}\nNEO4J_PLUGINS=[\"apoc\"]\nNEO4J_dbms_security_procedures_unrestricted=apoc.*\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Persistent Volume:**\n- Path: &#96;/data&#96;\n- Coolify Persistent Storage\n\n**Ports:**\n- HTTP: 7474\n- Bolt: 7687\n\n### 5. Tempo (Optional, Observability)\n\n**Docker Image:** &#96;grafana/tempo:2.6.0&#96;\n\n**Config File:** Via Volume Mount oder ConfigMap\n**Port:** 4318 (OTLP)\n\n---\n\n## Application Konfigurationen\n\n### 1. persona-web (Next.js Frontend)\n\n**Build Configuration:**\n- **Buildpack:** Dockerfile\n- **Dockerfile:** &#96;apps/web/Dockerfile&#96;\n- **Build Context:** Repository Root\n- **Build Args:**\n  - &#96;NODE_IMAGE=node:22.11.0-alpine&#96;\n  - &#96;RUN_WEB_BUILD=true&#96;\n\n**Environment Variables:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Public URLs (Coolify generiert automatisch)\nNEXT_PUBLIC_INDEXING_API_URL=https://indexing-api.{domain}/api/indexing\nNEXT_PUBLIC_CHAT_API_URL=https://chat-api.{domain}/api/chat\nNEXT_PUBLIC_WS_BASE_URL=wss://chat-api.{domain}/api/chat\nNEXT_PUBLIC_PERSONA_BACKEND_URL=https://persona-api.{domain}/api/persona-backend\nNEXT_PUBLIC_PERSONA_BACKEND_DOCS_URL=https://persona-api.{domain}/api/persona-backend/docs\n\n# Internal URLs (für Server-Side Requests)\nNEXT_BACKEND_INTERNAL_URL=http://coolify-internal-indexing-api:8000\nNEXT_CHAT_API_INTERNAL_URL=http://coolify-internal-chat-api:8001\nNEXT_PERSONA_BACKEND_INTERNAL_URL=http://coolify-internal-persona-api:8000\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Port:** 3000\n**Health Check:** &#96;GET /&#96;\n\n**Traefik Labels (via Coolify UI):**\n- Domain: &#96;persona-chat.{domain}&#96;\n- Path: &#96;/&#96;\n\n### 2. persona-api (FastAPI Backend)\n\n**Build Configuration:**\n- **Buildpack:** Dockerfile\n- **Dockerfile:** &#96;apps/api/Dockerfile&#96;\n- **Build Context:** Repository Root\n\n**Environment Variables:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",

        "contents": "# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1.7\n\nARG NODE_IMAGE=node:22.11.0-alpine\n\nFROM ${NODE_IMAGE} AS base\nWORKDIR /app\nENV NODE_ENV=development \\\n    NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 \\\n    NEXT_CACHE_DIR=/app/apps/web/.next/cache\nRUN corepack enable &amp;&amp; npm config set fund false &amp;&amp; npm config set audit false\n\nFROM base AS deps\nCOPY package.json package-lock.json ./\nCOPY tsconfig.base.json ./\nCOPY apps/web/package.json apps/web/\nCOPY packages/types/package.json packages/types/\nRUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.npm npm ci --include-workspace-root --install-links\n\nFROM deps AS builder\nARG RUN_WEB_BUILD=false\nCOPY packages/types packages/types\nCOPY apps/web apps/web\nRUN npm run build --workspace packages/types\nRUN mkdir -p apps/web/.next\nRUN --mount=type=cache,target=/tmp/.next-cache \\\n    sh -c 'if [ \"${RUN_WEB_BUILD}\" = \"true\" ]; then npm run build:web; else echo \"Skipping Next.js build\"; fi'\n\nFROM base AS runner\nCOPY --from=deps /app/node_modules ./node_modules\nCOPY package.json package-lock.json ./\nCOPY tsconfig.base.json ./\nCOPY packages/types packages/types\nCOPY --from=builder /app/packages/types/dist ./packages/types/dist\nCOPY apps/web apps/web\nCOPY --from=builder /app/apps/web/.next ./apps/web/.next\nEXPOSE 3000\nCMD [\"npm\", \"run\", \"dev:web\"]",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {

          {

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "FROM ${NODE_IMAGE} AS base",
            "lineNumber": 5

          {
            "text": "WORKDIR /app",

          {
            "text": "ENV NODE_ENV=development \\",

        "contents": "- **Indexing API**: &#96;https://192.168.50.101/audion/api/indexing&#96;\n\n### Globale Services (unverändert)\n- **Neo4j Browser**: &#96;https://192.168.50.101/neo4j/browser&#96;\n- **Qdrant Dashboard**: &#96;https://192.168.50.101/qdrant/&#96;\n\n## Deployment\n\nNach den Änderungen müssen folgende Schritte ausgeführt werden:\n\n1. **Nginx neu laden**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   docker exec persona-nginx nginx -s reload\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n   Oder Container neu starten:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   docker-compose restart nginx\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. **Web-Container neu bauen** (wichtig für basePath):\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   docker-compose build web\n   docker-compose up -d web\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n3. **Services neu starten**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   docker-compose restart web nginx\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Testing\n\nNach dem Deployment sollte überprüft werden:\n\n- ✅ &#96;https://192.168.50.101/audion/&#96; zeigt die Audion-Startseite\n- ✅ &#96;https://192.168.50.101/dashboard&#96; zeigt weiterhin den anderen Service\n- ✅ API-Endpunkte funktionieren unter &#96;/audion/api/...&#96;\n- ✅ WebSocket-Verbindungen funktionieren\n- ✅ Alle internen Links und Assets werden korrekt geladen\n\n## Rückgängig machen\n\nFalls die Migration rückgängig gemacht werden soll:\n\n1. Nginx-Konfiguration: Alle &#96;/audion&#96; Routen zurück zu &#96;/&#96; ändern\n2. Next.js Config: &#96;basePath&#96; entfernen oder auf &#96;''&#96; setzen\n3.         "contents": "# Frontend Performance Optimization - 05. Dezember 2025\n\n## Status: ✅ Implementiert\n\n## Durchgeführte Optimierungen\n\n### 1. React Compiler aktiviert\n- **Status:** ✅ Aktiviert\n- **Datei:** &#96;apps/web/next.config.mjs&#96;\n- **Vorteile:**\n  - Automatische Component-Optimierung\n  - Reduzierter Bedarf für manuelle Optimierungen\n  - Bessere Runtime-Performance\n\n### 2. Next.js Build-Optimierungen\n**Datei:** &#96;apps/web/next.config.mjs&#96;\n\n**Hinzugefügt:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\ncompiler: {\n  removeConsole: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' ? {\n    exclude: ['error', 'warn'],\n  } : false,\n},\nswcMinify: true,\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Vorteile:**\n- Console.log entfernt in Production (kleinere Bundle)\n- SWC Minification (schneller als Terser)\n- Bessere Build-Performance\n\n## Verbleibende Optimierungen\n\n### 3. Code Splitting\n**Status:** ✅ Implementiert\n\n**Implementierte Komponenten:**\n- ✅ &#96;PromptBuilder&#96; - Dynamisches Import implementiert\n- ⏭️ &#96;JourneyCanvas&#96; - Ausstehend\n- ⏭️ &#96;KnowledgeExplorer&#96; - Ausstehend\n\n**Implementierung:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// PromptBuilder Code Splitting\nimport dynamic from \"next/dynamic\";\n\nconst PromptBuilder = dynamic(\n  () =&gt; import(\"../../../../components/prompt-builder/PromptBuilder\").then((mod) =&gt; ({ default: mod.PromptBuilder })),\n  {\n    loading: () =&gt; &lt;div&gt;Loading prompt builder...&lt;/div&gt;,\n    ssr: false,\n  }\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 4. Bundle Size Analyse\n**Status:** ✅ Eingerichtet\n\n**Tools:**\n- ✅ &#96;@next/bundle-analyzer&#96; installiert\n- ✅ next.config.mjs konfiguriert\n- ✅ Script hinzugefügt: &#96;npm run build:analyze&#96;\n\n**Verwendung:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm run build:analyze\n# Öffnet Bundle-Analyse in Browser automatisch\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 5. Image Optimization\n**Status:** ⏭️ Zu prüfen\n\n**Empfehlungen:**\n- Next.js Image Component nutzen\n- Lazy Loading für Bilder\n- WebP Format wo möglich\n\n### 6. Font Optimization\n**Status:** ⏭️ Zu prüfen\n\n**Aktuell:** Noto Sans JP via Google Fonts\n**Empfehlung:** \n- &#96;next/font&#96; für optimiertes Font-Loading\n- Font-Display optimieren\n\n## Performance-Metriken\n\n### Vorher (Baseline)",

        "contents": "import { getPersonaBackendBase } from \"../_lib/backend\";\n\nexport async function GET() {\n  try {\n    // Use internal URL for server-side requests\n    const personaBackendBase = getPersonaBackendBase({ preferPublic: false });\n    console.log(\"[api/personas] Using persona backend base:\", personaBackendBase);\n    \n    const url = &#96;${personaBackendBase}/personas&#96;;\n    console.log(\"[api/personas] Fetching from:\", url);\n    \n    const response = await fetch(url, {\n      method: \"GET\",\n      headers: {\n        \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\",\n      },\n      cache: \"no-store\",\n      // Add timeout to avoid hanging requests\n      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(10000),\n    });\n\n    if (!response.ok) {\n      const errorText = await response.text();\n      console.error(\"Persona Backend error:\", response.status, errorText);\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: &#96;Persona Backend error: ${response.status} ${errorText}&#96; },\n        { status: response.status }\n      );\n    }\n\n    const data = await response.json();\n    console.log(\"[api/personas] Received data:\", { total: data.total, itemsCount: data.items?.length || 0 });\n    return NextResponse.json(data);\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error(\"[api/personas] Failed to fetch personas:\", error);\n    if (error instanceof Error) {\n      const errorMessage = error.message || String(error);\n}",

          "endPosition": {

        },
        "contents": "- Nginx proxy enforces &#96;client_max_body_size 200m&#96;, so uploads to &#96;/api/persona-backend&#96; (documents, knowledge attachments, avatars) avoid 413 responses for larger files.\n- **Reverse proxy path**: keep the &#96;/api/persona-backend&#96; prefix when forwarding to &#96;persona-api&#96;. FastAPI already sets &#96;root_path=/api/persona-backend&#96;, so removing the prefix breaks routes like &#96;/api/persona-backend/ai-assist&#96;.\n- &#96;NEO4J_BROWSER_URL&#96; / &#96;NEO4J_BLOOM_URL&#96; → optional deep links for graph introspection; response metadata exposes &#96;graphUrl&#96; + &#96;graphBloomUrl&#96;.\n\n## Access URLs\n- Local dev: &#96;http://localhost:8000/docs&#96; (FastAPI docs) once &#96;uv run fastapi dev app/main.py --port 8000&#96; or &#96;docker compose up persona-api&#96;.\n- Staging via nginx: &#96;https://192.168.50.101/api/persona-backend&#96; (proxied to &#96;persona-api&#96; service). Save this in &#96;PERSONA_BACKEND_PUBLIC_URL&#96; and reference in clients instead of hardcoding.\n- Persona Admin UI: &#96;https://192.168.50.101/personas/admin&#96; (Next.js app consuming persona backend via &#96;/api/persona-backend&#96;). Links to API docs at &#96;https://192.168.50.101/api/persona-backend/docs&#96;.\n\n## Knowledge Architecture: Dokumente, Wissensbasis, Sources\n\nDas System verwaltet Wissen für Personas in drei Ebenen:\n\n### 1. **Dokumente** (&#96;Document&#96; Model)\n- **Was**: Die hochgeladenen Rohdateien (PDF, DOCX, PPTX, Audio, etc.)\n- **Speicherort**: S3-compatible Storage (MinIO) via &#96;object_key&#96;\n- **Status**: &#96;processing&#96; → &#96;completed&#96; / &#96;failed&#96; (via &#96;ProcessingJob&#96;)\n- **Zugriff**: &#96;GET /personas/{id}/documents/{docId}/download&#96; streamt die Datei\n- **Zweck**: Persistente Speicherung der Originaldateien für spätere Referenz\n\n### 2. **Wissensbasis** (Qdrant Vector DB + &#96;DocumentChunk&#96; Model)\n- **Was**: Die verarbeiteten, vektorisierten Textchunks aus den Dokumenten\n- **Speicherort**: \n  - Qdrant Collection &#96;research_chunks&#96; (Vektoren + Payloads mit &#96;document_id&#96;, &#96;chunk_id&#96;, &#96;persona_id&#96;, &#96;content&#96;)\n  - PostgreSQL &#96;document_chunks&#96; Tabelle (Metadaten: &#96;order&#96;, &#96;length&#96;)\n- **Erstellung**: Automatisch via &#96;IngestionService.ingest()&#96; nach Dokument-Upload\n  - Partitionierung via &#96;unstructured.partition.auto&#96;",
