        "contents": "# Journey Mapper Feature - Deployment\n\n## Status\n\n✅ **Alle Code-Änderungen sind implementiert:**\n- Backend: Models, Schemas, Router, Services, Tasks, Migration\n- Frontend: Pages, Components, API Client\n- Tests und Dokumentation\n\n## Deployment\n\n### Voraussetzungen\n\n1. Docker/OrbStack muss laufen\n2. Alle Services müssen erreichbar sein\n\n### Deployment-Schritte\n\n**Option 1: Automatisches Script**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n./deploy-journey-mapper.sh\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Option 2: Manuell**\n\n1. **Backend Image neu bauen:**\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   cd infrastructure\n   docker compose build persona-api\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. **Service starten:**\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   docker compose up -d persona-api\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n3. **Migration ausführen:**\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   docker compose exec persona-api python -m alembic upgrade head\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n4. **Frontend Build (optional, für Production):**\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   cd apps/web\n   npm run build\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n5. **Web Service neu starten (falls Frontend gebaut):**\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   cd infrastructure\n   docker compose restart web\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Verifikation\n\n1. **Migration Status prüfen:**\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   docker compose exec persona-api python -m alembic current\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n   Sollte zeigen: &#96;20251126_1749_journey_mapper (head)&#96;\n\n2. **API Endpoints testen:**\n   - API Docs: http://localhost/api/persona-backend/docs\n   - Journey Endpoints: http://localhost/api/persona-backend/journeys\n\n3. **Frontend prüfen:**\n   - Journey List: http://localhost/admin/journeys\n\n### Bekannte Issues\n\n- ✅ **Behoben:** &#96;metadata&#96; Attribut-Konflikt → zu &#96;element_metadata&#96; geändert\n- Die Datenbank-Spalte bleibt &#96;metadata&#96;, nur das Python-Attribut ist &#96;element_metadata&#96;\n\n### Troubleshooting\n\n**Docker nicht erreichbar:**\n- OrbStack neu starten: &#96;open -a OrbStack&#96;\n- Oder Docker Desktop starten\n\n**Migration-Fehler:**\n- Prüfe Logs: &#96;docker compose logs persona-api&#96;\n- Prüfe Datenbank-Verbindung\n\n**Service startet nicht:**\n- Prüfe Logs: &#96;docker compose logs persona-api --tail=50&#96;\n- Prüfe ob alle Dependencies vorhanden sind",

        "contents": "**Technologien:**\n- FastAPI\n- SQLAlchemy\n- Celery\n- Pydantic\n\n**Hauptfunktionen:**\n- Persona CRUD Operations\n- Target Groups Management\n- Document Management\n- Knowledge Entries Management\n- Queue Management\n- Service Status Monitoring\n\n**Commands:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncd apps/api\nuv sync                    # Dependencies installieren\nuv run fastapi dev app/main.py --port 8000  # Development Server\nuv run celery -A app.celery_app worker -Q ingestion -l INFO  # Worker\nuv run pytest              # Tests\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 3. Chat API (Real-time Chat Service)\n\n**Pfad:** &#96;apps/chat-api/&#96;\n\n**Technologien:**\n- FastAPI\n- WebSocket\n- Anthropic Claude API\n- Vector Retrieval\n\n**Hauptfunktionen:**\n- Real-time Chat (WebSocket)\n- Persona Discovery\n- Persona Generation\n- Voice Streaming\n- Retrieval Agent Integration\n\n**Commands:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncd apps/chat-api\nuv sync\nuv run fastapi dev app/main.py --port 8001\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 4. Indexing API (Document Processing)\n\n**Pfad:** &#96;apps/indexing-api/&#96;\n\n**Technologien:**\n- FastAPI\n- Unstructured\n- FlagEmbedding (BGE-M3)\n- faster-whisper\n\n**Hauptfunktionen:**\n- Document Upload &amp; Processing\n- Text Extraction\n- Audio Transkription\n- Chunking &amp; Embedding\n- Qdrant Integration\n\n**Commands:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncd apps/indexing-api\nuv sync\nuv run fastapi dev app/main.py --port 8000\nuv run celery -A app.workers.process worker -Q indexing -l info\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 5. Workers (Celery)\n\n**Persona Worker:**\n- Queue: &#96;ingestion&#96;\n- Tasks: Document Ingestion, Persona Generation\n\n**Indexing Worker:**\n- Queue: &#96;indexing&#96;\n- Tasks: Document Processing, Embedding Generation\n\n---\n\n## Setup und Installation\n\n### Voraussetzungen\n\n- Docker &amp; Docker Compose\n- Node.js 22+ (für lokale Web-Entwicklung)\n- Python 3.12+ (für lokale Backend-Entwicklung)\n- uv (Python Package Manager)\n\n### Environment-Variablen\n\n**Root &#96;.env&#96; Datei erstellen:**\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# AI APIs\nANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-api03-...\nCLAUDE_API_KEY=${ANTHROPIC_API_KEY}  # Alias\nOPENAI_API_KEY=sk-...  # Für Persona Image Generation\n\n# Voice (Optional)\nELEVENLABS_API_KEY=...\nELEVENLABS_VOICE_ID=...",

        "contents": "- Testable (can inject mocks)\n- Flexible (can use different embedders/collections)\n- Maintains backward compatibility\n\n### 3. Integration Test\n\nCreated comprehensive integration test (&#96;tests/test_documents_upload.py&#96;):\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;python\n@pytest.mark.asyncio\nasync def test_upload_document_persists_file_under_data_dir(\n    tmp_path: Path, \n    session: Session, \n    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch\n) -&gt; None:\n    os.environ[\"DATA_DIR\"] = str(tmp_path)\n    \n    # Mock Celery enqueue to capture arguments\n    captured: dict[str, str] = {}\n    def fake_enqueue(document_id: str, file_path: str) -&gt; None:\n        captured[\"document_id\"] = document_id\n        captured[\"file_path\"] = file_path\n    \n    monkeypatch.setattr(documents, \"enqueue_ingestion\", fake_enqueue)\n    \n    # Create upload\n    payload = b\"%PDF-1.4 mock content\"\n    upload = UploadFile(filename=\"insights.pdf\", file=BytesIO(payload))\n    upload.headers = {\"content-type\": \"application/pdf\"}\n    upload.size = len(payload)\n    \n    # Upload document\n    response = await documents.upload_document(file=upload, session=session)\n    \n    # Verify file was persisted\n    assert \"document_id\" in captured\n    persisted_path = Path(captured[\"file_path\"])\n    assert persisted_path.exists()\n    assert persisted_path.read_bytes() == payload\n    \n    # Verify job was created\n    job = session.query(ProcessingJob).one()\n    assert str(job.id) == response.job_id\n    assert job.status == \"pending\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Benefits:**\n- Validates full upload → storage → enqueue flow\n- Catches path mismatches early\n- Tests with temporary directories (no filesystem pollution)\n\n### 4.         "contents": "\"\"\"\nIntegration Tests für Database Query Optimierungen\n\nTestet die SQLAlchemy 2.0 Migration und Query-Performance\n\"\"\"\n\nimport pytest\nfrom uuid import uuid4\nfrom sqlalchemy import select\nfrom sqlalchemy.orm import Session\n\nfrom apps.api.app.db import get_session\nfrom apps.api.app.models import Persona, Document, ProcessingJob, TargetGroup\n\n\n@pytest.mark.integration\nclass TestDatabaseQueries:\n    \"\"\"Tests für optimierte Database Queries\"\"\"\n    \n    def test_persona_query_with_select(self):\n        \"\"\"Test dass Persona-Queries mit select() Syntax funktionieren\"\"\"\n        with get_session() as session:\n            # SQLAlchemy 2.0 Syntax\n            result = session.scalars(\n                select(Persona).where(Persona.status == \"published\").limit(10)\n            ).all()\n            \n            assert isinstance(result, list)\n            # Alle Ergebnisse sollten Persona-Instanzen sein\n            for persona in result:\n                assert isinstance(persona, Persona)\n    \n    def test_document_query_with_target_group_filter(self):\n        \"\"\"Test dass Document-Queries mit target_group_id Filter funktionieren\"\"\"\n        with get_session() as session:\n            # Alle Dokumente sollten zur target_group gehören\n            for doc in result:\n                assert doc.target_group_id == target_group_id\n    \n    def test_processing_job_query(self):\n        \"\"\"Test ProcessingJob Queries\"\"\"\n        with get_session() as session:\n            # Test mit select() Syntax\n            result = session.scalars(\n                select(ProcessingJob).where(ProcessingJob.status == \"pending\")\n            ).all()\n            \n            assert isinstance(result, list)\n    \n    def test_composite_query_personas_status_target_group(self):\n        \"\"\"Test Composite Index Query (status + target_group_id)\"\"\"",

        "contents": "2. **AI-generiert:** Nutze &#96;JourneyGenerationService.generate_journey_from_knowledge()&#96;\n3. **Hybrid:** Kombiniere manuelle und AI-generierte Phasen\n\n### Journey validieren\n\n1.         "contents": "@router.post(\n    \"/{persona_id}/documents/{document_id}/retry\",\n    response_model=PersonaDocument,\n    summary=\"Retry ingestion for a failed document\",\n    description=\"\"\"\n    Retry the ingestion process for a document that previously failed or is stuck in processing.\n    \n    This endpoint resets the processing job status and re-enqueues the document for ingestion.\n    Useful when a document processing job failed due to transient errors or got stuck in\n    a processing state.\n    \n    **Parameters:**\n    - &#96;persona_id&#96;: The unique identifier of the persona (UUID format)\n    - &#96;document_id&#96;: The unique identifier of the document to retry (UUID format)\n    \n    **Returns:**\n    - The document object with reset status (\"processing\") and cleared error information.\n    \n    **Note:** The document's processing job is reset to \"pending\" status and re-enqueued.\n    Any previous error messages are cleared. The document must have a valid file path in storage.\n    The persona cache is automatically invalidated after retry.\n    \"\"\"\n)\ndef retry_persona_document_ingestion(\n    persona_id: str,\n    document_id: str,\n    session: Session = Depends(get_db),\n) -&gt; PersonaDocument:\n    \"\"\"Retry ingestion for a document that failed or is stuck.\"\"\"\n    persona = _get_persona_or_404(session, persona_id)\n    try:\n        document_uuid = UUID(document_id)\n    except ValueError as exc:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=\"Invalid document id\") from exc\n    document = session.get(Document, document_uuid)\n    if not document or document.persona_id != persona.id:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"Document not found\")\n    \n    if not document.file_path:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=\"Document file path missing\")\n    \n    # Get or create processing job\n    job = session.scalar(\n        select(ProcessingJob).where(ProcessingJob.document_id == document_uuid)\n    )\n    if not job:\n        job = ProcessingJob(document_id=document_uuid, status=\"pending\", progress=0)\n        session.add(job)\n    \n    # Reset job status\n    job.status = \"pending\"\n    job.progress = 0\n    job.error = None\n    document.status = \"processing\"\n    session.commit()\n    \n    # Get the persistent file path for ingestion\n    from ..core.config import get_settings\n    settings = get_settings()\n    data_dir = Path(settings.data_dir)\n    # document.file_path is relative to data_dir (e.g., \"personas/.../file.pdf\")\n    # Construct full path: data_dir / file_path\n    file_path_clean = document.file_path.lstrip(\"/\")\n    persistent_file = data_dir / file_path_clean\n    \n    # Enqueue ingestion task\n    enqueue_ingestion(str(document.id), str(persistent_file))\n    \n    session.refresh(document)\n    persona_service.invalidate_cache(persona_id)\n    return persona_service.serialize_document(document, session=session)\n\n\n@router.delete(\n    \"/{persona_id}/documents/{document_id}\",\n    status_code=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT,\n    summary=\"Delete a persona document\",\n    description=\"\"\"\n    Permanently delete a document and all its associated data from the system.\n    \n    This endpoint performs a complete cleanup of a document including:\n    - Removing the document file from storage\n    - Deleting all document chunks from the vector database (Qdrant)\n    - Removing all chunks from the database\n    - Deleting the processing job record\n    - Removing the document record itself\n    \n    **Parameters:**\n    - &#96;persona_id&#96;: The unique identifier of the persona (UUID format)\n    - &#96;document_id&#96;: The unique identifier of the document to delete (UUID format)\n    \n    **Returns:**\n    - 204 No Content on successful deletion\n    \n    **Note:** This is a permanent deletion operation.         "contents": "from __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom uuid import UUID\n\nimport structlog\n\nfrom sqlalchemy import select\n\nfrom app.db import get_session\nfrom app.models import ProcessingJob\nfrom app.services.ingestion import IngestionService\nfrom app.services.celery_health import check_worker_available\nfrom app.celery_app import celery_app\n\nlogger = structlog.get_logger(__name__)\ningestion_service = IngestionService()\n\n\n@celery_app.task(name=\"worker.ingest.ingest_document\", bind=True, max_retries=0)\ndef ingest_document(self, document_id: str, file_path: str) -&gt; None:\n    logger.info(\"ingest.task.received\", document_id=document_id, file_path=file_path, task_id=self.request.id)\n    try:\n        # Normalize the file path - remove any duplicate 'uploads' segments\n        path_str = str(file_path)\n        # Fix double 'uploads/uploads' if present\n        if '/uploads/uploads/' in path_str:\n            path_str = path_str.replace('/uploads/uploads/', '/uploads/')\n        file_path_obj = Path(path_str)\n        logger.info(\"ingest.task.start\", document_id=document_id, file_path=str(file_path_obj), normalized_path=str(file_path_obj))\n        \n        if not file_path_obj.exists():\n            logger.error(\"ingest.task.file_not_found\", document_id=document_id, file_path=str(file_path_obj))\n            # Update job status to failed\n            with get_session() as session:\n                job = session.scalar(\n                    select(ProcessingJob).where(ProcessingJob.document_id == UUID(document_id))\n                )\n                if job:\n                    job.status = \"failed\"\n                    job.error = f\"File not found: {file_path_obj}\"\n                    session.commit()\n            raise FileNotFoundError(f\"File not found: {file_path_obj}\")\n        \n        logger.info(\"ingest.task.calling_service\", document_id=document_id)\n        ingestion_service.ingest(document_id=UUID(document_id), file_path=file_path_obj)\n        logger.info(\"ingest.task.completed\", document_id=document_id)\n    except Exception as exc:\n        logger.error",

        },
        "contents": "@router.post(\n    \"/{persona_id}/documents\",\n    response_model=PersonaDocument,\n    status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED,\n    summary=\"Upload a document for a persona\",\n    description=\"\"\"\n    Upload a document file to be associated with a persona and processed for knowledge extraction.\n    \n    This endpoint accepts a file upload, stores it in persistent storage, and enqueues it for\n    asynchronous processing. The document will be processed to extract text, create chunks,\n    generate embeddings, and store them in the vector database for persona-related knowledge retrieval.\n    \n    **Parameters:**\n    - &#96;persona_id&#96;: The unique identifier of the persona to associate the document with (UUID format)\n    - &#96;file&#96;: The document file to upload (multipart/form-data, supports PDF, DOCX, TXT, etc.)\n    - &#96;uploaded_by&#96;: Optional identifier of who uploaded the document (default: \"persona-admin-ui\")\n    \n    **Returns:**\n    - The created document object with processing status \"processing\" and a unique document ID.\n    \n    **Note:** Processing happens asynchronously. Use the document status endpoint or list documents\n    to check processing progress. The document will be chunked, embedded, and made searchable\n    once processing completes. The persona cache is automatically invalidated after upload.\n    \"\"\"\n)\nasync def upload_persona_document(\n    persona_id: str,\n    file: UploadFile = File(...),\n    uploaded_by: str = Form(\"persona-admin-ui\"),\n    session: Session = Depends(get_db),\n) -&gt; PersonaDocument:\n    persona = _get_persona_or_404(session, persona_id)\n    contents = await file.read()\n    if not contents:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=\"File was empty\")\n    content_type = file.content_type or \"application/octet-stream\"\n    filename = file.filename or \"upload.bin\"\n    document_id = uuid4()\n    key = f\"personas/{persona_id}/documents/{document_id}/{filename}\"\n    \n    # Create document with processing status\n    document = Document(\n        id=document_id,\n        filename=filename,\n        content_type=content_type,\n        size_bytes=len(contents),\n        status=\"processing\",\n        object_key=key,\n        file_path=key,\n        persona_id=persona.id,\n        uploaded_by=uploaded_by,\n    )\n    session.add(document)\n    session.flush()\n    \n    # Create processing job\n    job = ProcessingJob(document_id=document.id, status=\"pending\", progress=0)\n    session.add(job)\n    session.commit()\n    \n    # Store file in filesystem (persistent storage for ingestion)\n    storage.upload(key=key, data=contents, content_type=content_type)\n    \n    # Get the persistent file path for ingestion (same as storage path)\n    from ..core.config import get_settings\n    settings = get_settings()\n    data_dir = Path(settings.data_dir)\n    persistent_file = data_dir / key.lstrip(\"/\")\n    \n    # Enqueue ingestion task with persistent file path\n    import structlog\n    logger = structlog.get_logger(__name__)\n    logger.info(\"document.upload.enqueue\", document_id=str(document.id), file_path=str(persistent_file), persona_id=str(persona_id))\n    enqueue_ingestion(str(document.id), str(persistent_file))\n    logger.info(\"document.upload.enqueued\", document_id=str(document.id))\n    \n    session.refresh(document)\n    persona_service.invalidate_cache(persona_id)\n    return persona_service.serialize_document(document, session=session)\n\n\n@router.get(\n    \"/{persona_id}/knowledge\",\n    response_model=List[PersonaKnowledgeEntrySchema],\n    summary=\"List knowledge entries for a persona\",\n    description=\"\"\"\n    Retrieve all manual knowledge entries that have been added to a persona.\n    \n    This endpoint returns a list of knowledge entries that were manually created and\n    associated with the persona. These entries complement the automatically extracted\n    knowledge from documents and can include domain-specific insights, observations,\n    or additional context about the persona.\n    \n    **Parameters:**\n    - &#96;persona_id&#96;: The unique identifier of the persona (UUID format)\n    \n    **Returns:**\n    - A list of knowledge entry objects, each containing:\n      - Entry ID and title\n      - Content text\n      - Optional metadata payload\n      - Creator information and timestamps\n    \n    **Note:** Knowledge entries are separate from document-derived knowledge chunks.\n    These are manually curated entries that provide additional context for the persona.\n    \"\"\"\n)",

        "contents": "@router.post(\n    \"/{target_group_id}/documents\",\n    response_model=PersonaDocument,\n    status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED,\n    summary=\"Upload a document for a target group\",\n    description=f\"\"\"\n    Upload a document file to be associated with a target group and processed for knowledge extraction.\n    \n    This endpoint accepts a file upload, stores it in persistent storage, and enqueues it for\n    asynchronous processing. The document will be processed to extract text, create chunks,\n    generate embeddings, and store them in the vector database. The chunks will be automatically\n    linked to the target group through TargetGroupSource relationships.\n    \n    **Parameters:**\n    - &#96;target_group_id&#96;: The unique identifier of the target group to associate the document with (UUID format)\n    - &#96;file&#96;: The document file to upload (multipart/form-data, supports PDF, DOCX, TXT, etc.)\n    - &#96;uploaded_by&#96;: Optional identifier of who uploaded the document (default: \"target-group-admin-ui\")\n    \n    **Returns:**\n    - The created document object with processing status \"processing\" and a unique document ID.\n    \n    **Note:** Processing happens asynchronously. Use the document status endpoint or list documents\n    to check processing progress. Once processed, document chunks will be automatically associated\n    with the target group and available for persona generation and knowledge retrieval.\n    \n    **Schemas:**\n    - Response: &#96;PersonaDocument&#96; (see {SCHEMA_SOURCE_PATH})\n    - Request: multipart upload fields documented in {TARGET_GROUP_DOC_SECTION}\n    \"\"\"\n)\nasync def upload_target_group_document(\n    target_group_id: str,\n    file: UploadFile = File(...),\n    uploaded_by: str = Form(\"target-group-admin-ui\"),\n    session: Session = Depends(get_db),\n) -&gt; PersonaDocument:\n    tg = _get_target_group_or_404(session, target_group_id)\n    contents = await file.read()\n    if not contents:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=\"File was empty\")\n    content_type = file.content_type or \"application/octet-stream\"\n    filename = file.filename or \"upload.bin\"\n    document_id = uuid4()\n    key = f\"target-groups/{target_group_id}/documents/{document_id}/{filename}\"\n\n    # Create document with processing status\n    document = Document(\n        id=document_id,\n        filename=filename,\n        content_type=content_type,\n        size_bytes=len(contents),\n        status=\"processing\",\n        object_key=key,\n        file_path=key,\n        target_group_id=tg.id,\n        uploaded_by=uploaded_by,\n    )\n    session.add(document)\n    session.flush()\n\n    # Create processing job\n    job = ProcessingJob(document_id=document.id, status=\"pending\", progress=0)\n    session.add(job)\n    session.commit()\n\n    # Store file in filesystem (persistent storage for ingestion)\n    storage.upload(key=key, data=contents, content_type=content_type)\n\n    # Get the persistent file path for ingestion (same as storage path)\n    from ..core.config import get_settings\n    settings = get_settings()\n    data_dir = Path(settings.data_dir)\n    persistent_file = data_dir / key.lstrip(\"/\")\n\n    # Enqueue ingestion task with persistent file path\n    logger.info(\"document.upload.enqueue\", document_id=str(document.id), file_path=str(persistent_file), target_group_id=str(target_group_id))\n    enqueue_ingestion(str(document.id), str(persistent_file))\n    logger.info(\"document.upload.enqueued\", document_id=str(document.id))\n\n    session.refresh(document)\n    return service._to_document_payload(document, session=session, target_group_id=target_group_id)\n\n\n@router.get(\n    \"/{target_group_id}/personas\",\n    response_model=PersonaListResponse,\n    summary=\"List all personas associated with a target group\",\n    description=f\"\"\"\n    Retrieve a paginated list of all personas that have been generated for or associated with a target group.\n    \n    This endpoint returns personas that are linked to the specified target group. You can filter\n    by status and search by name or attributes. Results are paginated for efficient retrieval.\n    \n    **Parameters:**\n    - &#96;target_group_id&#96;: The unique identifier of the target group (UUID format)\n    - &#96;status&#96;: Filter personas by status (optional)\n    - &#96;q&#96; (alias &#96;search&#96;): Search query to filter personas by name or attributes (optional)\n    - &#96;page&#96;: Page number for pagination (default: 1, minimum: 1)\n    - &#96;page_size&#96;: Number of items per page (default: 20, minimum: 1, maximum: 100)\n    \n    **Returns:**\n    - A paginated list of personas including total count, current page, and page size information.\n    Each persona includes its profile, demographics, goals, pain points, and other attributes.\n    \n    **Note:** Results are sorted by creation date (newest first) by default. Personas generated\n    from a target group are automatically associated with that target group and use its knowledge\n    base for generation.\n    \n    **Schemas:**\n    - Response: &#96;PersonaListResponse&#96; with items &#96;PersonaListItem&#96; (see {SCHEMA_SOURCE_PATH})\n    - Persona profile fields follow {PERSONA_SCHEMA_DOC}\n    \"\"\"\n)",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [

        "contents": "@router.post(\n    \"/upload\",\n    response_model=DocumentUploadResponse,\n    summary=\"Upload a document for processing\",\n    description=\"\"\"\n    Upload a document file for asynchronous processing and ingestion.\n    \n    This endpoint accepts a file upload, stores it in persistent storage, and enqueues it for processing.\n    The document will be processed asynchronously through the ingestion pipeline which includes:\n    - Text extraction and parsing\n    - Chunking and embedding generation\n    - Storage in Qdrant vector database\n    - Graph database integration\n    \n    **Parameters:**\n    - &#96;file&#96;: The document file to upload (supports various formats including PDF, DOCX, TXT, etc.)\n    \n    **Returns:**\n    - &#96;job_id&#96;: A unique identifier for the processing job. Use this to check the job status via the status endpoint.\n    \n    **Note:** Processing happens asynchronously. Use the returned &#96;job_id&#96; to poll the status endpoint for progress updates.\n    \"\"\"\n)\nasync def upload_document(\n    file: UploadFile = File(...),\n    session: Session = Depends(get_db),\n) -&gt; DocumentUploadResponse:\n    filename = file.filename or f\"upload-{uuid4().hex}.bin\"\n    document_id = uuid4()\n    key = f\"documents/{document_id}/{filename}\"\n    document = Document(\n        id=document_id,\n        filename=filename,\n        content_type=file.content_type or \"application/octet-stream\",\n        size_bytes=file.size or 0,\n        status=\"processing\",\n        file_path=key,\n        object_key=key,\n    )\n    session.add(document)\n    session.flush()\n\n    job = ProcessingJob(document_id=document.id, status=\"pending\", progress=0)\n    session.add(job)\n    session.commit()\n\n    contents = await file.read()\n\n    # Store file in filesystem (persistent storage for ingestion)\n    storage.upload(key=key, data=contents, content_type=document.content_type)\n    \n    # Get the persistent file path for ingestion (same as storage path)\n    from ..core.config import get_settings\n    settings = get_settings()\n    data_dir = Path(settings.data_dir)\n    persistent_file = data_dir / key.lstrip(\"/\")\n\n    enqueue_ingestion(str(document.id), str(persistent_file))\n\n    return DocumentUploadResponse(job_id=str(job.id))\n\n\n@router.get(\n    \"/{job_id}/status\",\n    summary=\"Get the status of a document processing job\",\n    description=\"\"\"\n    Retrieve the current status of a document processing job.\n    \n    This endpoint allows you to check the progress of a document that was uploaded for processing.\n    The status can be one of:\n    - &#96;pending&#96;: The job is queued and waiting to be processed\n    - &#96;processing&#96;: The document is currently being processed (includes progress percentage)\n    - &#96;completed&#96;: The processing finished successfully (includes the document ID)\n    - &#96;failed&#96;: The processing encountered an error (includes error reason)\n    \n    **Parameters:**\n    - &#96;job_id&#96;: The unique identifier of the processing job (returned from the upload endpoint)\n    \n    **Returns:**\n    - Status information including:\n      - Current status (&#96;pending&#96;, &#96;processing&#96;, &#96;completed&#96;, or &#96;failed&#96;)\n      - Progress percentage (0-100) when status is &#96;processing&#96;\n      - Document ID when status is &#96;completed&#96;\n      - Error reason when status is &#96;failed&#96;\n    \n    **Usage:** Poll this endpoint periodically to track processing progress until the status is either &#96;completed&#96; or &#96;failed&#96;.\n    \"\"\"\n)",

        "contents": "class QueueService:\n\n\n    def retry_failed_job(self, session: Session, job_id: str) -&gt; ProcessingJobDetailResponse:\n        \"\"\"Retry a failed processing job.\"\"\"\n        try:\n            job_uuid = UUID(job_id)\n        except ValueError:\n            raise ValueError(\"invalid_job_id\")\n\n        job = session.get(ProcessingJob, job_uuid)\n        if not job:\n            raise ValueError(\"job_not_found\")\n\n        if job.status != \"failed\":\n            raise ValueError(\"job_not_failed\")\n\n        # Get document\n        document = session.get(Document, job.document_id)\n        if not document:\n            raise ValueError(\"document_not_found\")\n\n        # Get file path\n        from pathlib import Path\n        from ..core.config import get_settings\n\n        settings = get_settings()\n        data_dir = Path(settings.data_dir)\n        file_path = data_dir / document.file_path.lstrip(\"/\")\n\n        if not file_path.exists():\n            raise ValueError(\"file_not_found\")\n\n        # Reset job status\n        job.status = \"pending\"\n        job.progress = 0.0\n        job.error = None\n        session.commit()\n\n        # Enqueue ingestion again\n        from worker.ingest import enqueue_ingestion\n\n        enqueue_ingestion(str(job.document_id), str(file_path))\n\n        return self.get_processing_job(session, job_id)",

      "codeBlock": {

            "line": 147
          }
        },
        "contents": "def process_pending_jobs(max_age_seconds: int = 300) -&gt; int:\n\n                    \n                    if not file_path.exists():\n                        logger.error(\n                            \"job_processor.file_not_found\",\n                            job_id=str(job.id),\n                            document_id=str(job.document_id),\n                            file_path=str(file_path),\n                        )\n                        job.status = \"failed\"\n                        job.error = f\"File not found: {file_path}\"\n                        session.commit()\n                        continue\n                    \n                    # Check if worker is available - if yes, try to enqueue again\n                    if check_worker_available():\n                        logger.info(\n                            \"job_processor.retrying_enqueue\",\n                            job_id=str(job.id),\n                            document_id=str(job.document_id),\n                        )\n                        # Try to enqueue again\n                        from worker.ingest import enqueue_ingestion\n                        enqueue_ingestion(str(job.document_id), str(file_path))\n                        continue\n                    \n                    # Worker not available -         "contents": "@router.delete(\n    \"/{persona_id}/documents/{document_id}\",\n    status_code=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT,\n    summary=\"Delete a persona document\",\n    description=\"\"\"\n    Permanently delete a document and all its associated data from the system.\n    \n    This endpoint performs a complete cleanup of a document including:\n    - Removing the document file from storage\n    - Deleting all document chunks from the vector database (Qdrant)\n    - Removing all chunks from the database\n    - Deleting the processing job record\n    - Removing the document record itself\n    \n    **Parameters:**\n    - &#96;persona_id&#96;: The unique identifier of the persona (UUID format)\n    - &#96;document_id&#96;: The unique identifier of the document to delete (UUID format)\n    \n    **Returns:**\n    - 204 No Content on successful deletion\n    \n    **Note:** This is a permanent deletion operation. All associated data including\n    embeddings and chunks are removed. This action cannot be undone. The persona cache\n    is automatically invalidated after deletion.\n    \"\"\"\n)\ndef delete_persona_document(\n    persona_id: str,\n    document_id: str,\n    session: Session = Depends(get_db),\n) -&gt; None:\n    \"\"\"Delete a document and all its associated data.\"\"\"\n    persona = _get_persona_or_404(session, persona_id)\n    try:\n        document_uuid = UUID(document_id)\n    except ValueError as exc:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=\"Invalid document id\") from exc\n    document = session.get(Document, document_uuid)\n    if not document or document.persona_id != persona.id:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"Document not found\")\n    \n    # Delete file from storage\n    if document.object_key:\n        try:\n            storage.delete(key=document.object_key)\n        except Exception:\n            pass  # File might not exist, continue with cleanup\n    \n    # Delete chunks from Qdrant\n    from ..core.config import get_settings\n    from qdrant_client import QdrantClient\n    from qdrant_client.http import models as qmodels\n    settings = get_settings()\n    try:\n        qdrant = QdrantClient(settings.qdrant_url)\n        collection = \"research_chunks\"\n        if qdrant.collection_exists(collection):\n            # Delete all points for this document\n            qdrant.delete(\n                collection_name=collection,\n                points_selector=qmodels.Filter(\n                    must=[\n                        qmodels.FieldCondition(\n                            key=\"document_id\",\n                            match=qmodels.MatchValue(value=str(document.id)),\n                        )\n                    ]\n                ),\n            )\n    except Exception:\n        pass  # Qdrant might not be available, continue with cleanup\n    \n    # Delete chunks from database\n    session.execute(delete(DocumentChunk).where(DocumentChunk.document_id == document_uuid))\n    \n    # Delete processing job\n    session.execute(delete(ProcessingJob).where(ProcessingJob.document_id == document_uuid))\n    \n    # Delete document\n    session.delete(document)\n    session.commit()\n    \n    persona_service.invalidate_cache(persona_id)\n\n\n@router.get(\n    \"/{persona_id}/avatar\",\n    summary=\"Get the avatar image for a persona\",\n    description=\"\"\"\n    Retrieve the avatar/profile image associated with a persona.\n    \n    This endpoint returns the avatar image for a persona. The image can be stored in\n    different formats: as a URL (external), as a data URI (base64 encoded), or as a\n    file in storage (internal). The endpoint handles all formats and streams the image\n    with appropriate content type headers.\n    \n    **Parameters:**\n    - &#96;persona_id&#96;: The unique identifier of the persona (UUID format)\n    \n    **Returns:**\n    - Streaming response with the avatar image:\n      - If image_url is an external URL: Redirect response to the external URL\n      - If image_url is a data URI: Binary image data extracted from the data URI\n      - If image_url is a storage key: Streaming response with image from storage\n      - Appropriate Content-Type header based on image format\n    \n    **Note:** If no avatar has been set for the persona, a 404 error is returned.\n    The endpoint automatically handles different image storage formats.\n    \"\"\"\n)",

        "contents": "def _process_directly(document_id: str, file_path: str) -&gt; None:\n    \"\"\"\n    Process ingestion directly without Celery (fallback mechanism).\n    \n    Args:\n        document_id: Document UUID\n        file_path: Path to the document file\n    \"\"\"\n    logger.info(\"enqueue.ingestion.processing_directly\", document_id=document_id, file_path=file_path)\n    \n    try:\n        file_path_obj = Path(file_path)\n        \n        if not file_path_obj.exists():\n            logger.error(\"enqueue.ingestion.file_not_found\", document_id=document_id, file_path=str(file_path_obj))\n            with get_session() as session:\n                job = session.scalar(\n                    select(ProcessingJob).where(ProcessingJob.document_id == UUID(document_id))\n                )\n                if job:\n                    job.status = \"failed\"\n                    job.error = f\"File not found: {file_path_obj}\"\n                    session.commit()\n            return\n        \n        # Update job status to processing\n        with get_session() as session:\n            job = session.scalar(\n                select(ProcessingJob).where(ProcessingJob.document_id == UUID(document_id))\n            )\n            if job:\n                job.status = \"processing\"\n                job.progress = 0\n                session.commit()\n        \n        # Process directly\n        ingestion_service.ingest(document_id=UUID(document_id), file_path=file_path_obj)\n        \n        logger.info(\"enqueue.ingestion.direct_processing_completed\", document_id=document_id)\n        \n    except Exception as exc:",

        "contents": "@router.get(\n    \"/{job_id}/status\",\n    summary=\"Get the status of a document processing job\",\n    description=\"\"\"\n    Retrieve the current status of a document processing job.\n    \n    This endpoint allows you to check the progress of a document that was uploaded for processing.\n    The status can be one of:\n    - &#96;pending&#96;: The job is queued and waiting to be processed\n    - &#96;processing&#96;: The document is currently being processed (includes progress percentage)\n    - &#96;completed&#96;: The processing finished successfully (includes the document ID)\n    - &#96;failed&#96;: The processing encountered an error (includes error reason)\n    \n    **Parameters:**\n    - &#96;job_id&#96;: The unique identifier of the processing job (returned from the upload endpoint)\n    \n    **Returns:**\n    - Status information including:\n      - Current status (&#96;pending&#96;, &#96;processing&#96;, &#96;completed&#96;, or &#96;failed&#96;)\n      - Progress percentage (0-100) when status is &#96;processing&#96;\n      - Document ID when status is &#96;completed&#96;\n      - Error reason when status is &#96;failed&#96;\n    \n    **Usage:** Poll this endpoint periodically to track processing progress until the status is either &#96;completed&#96; or &#96;failed&#96;.\n    \"\"\"\n)\ndef job_status(job_id: str, session: Session = Depends(get_db)) -&gt; UploadJobStatus:\n    job = session.get(ProcessingJob, job_id)\n    if not job:\n        return UploadJobStatus(status=\"failed\", reason=\"Job not found\")  # type: ignore[return-value]\n    if job.status == \"completed\":\n        return UploadJobStatus(status=\"completed\", document_id=str(job.document_id))  # type: ignore[return-value]\n    if job.status == \"failed\":\n        return UploadJobStatus(status=\"failed\", reason=job.error or \"Unknown error\")  # type: ignore[return-value]\n    return UploadJobStatus(status=\"processing\", progress=int(job.progress))  # type: ignore[return-value]",

        "contents": "# Indexing API\n\nDocument upload and processing service for Dynamic Persona Chat.\n\n## Features\n\n- Document upload (PDF, DOCX, TXT)\n- Async processing with Celery\n- Text chunking and embedding generation\n- Vector storage in Qdrant\n- Local file storage\n\n## Endpoints\n\n- &#96;POST /upload&#96; - Upload a document\n- &#96;GET /jobs/{job_id}/status&#96; - Get processing job status\n- &#96;GET /health&#96; - Health check\n- &#96;GET /health/ready&#96; - Readiness check\n\n## Environment Variables\n\n- &#96;DATA_DIR&#96; - Directory for storing uploaded files (default: &#96;./data/uploads&#96;)\n- &#96;DATABASE_URL&#96; - PostgreSQL connection string\n- &#96;REDIS_URL&#96; - Redis connection string for Celery\n- &#96;QDRANT_URL&#96; - Qdrant vector database URL",

Die Datenbank ist leer, da beim Löschen des PostgreSQL-Volumes zur Behebung des Authentifizierungsproblems alle Daten entfernt wurden. Die Dateien sind noch im Dateisystem vorhanden (`data/uploads/`), aber nicht in der Datenbank registriert.

**Zusammenfassung:**
- Datenbank: leer (0 personas, 0 target-groups, 0 documents)
- Dateisystem: Dateien vorhanden in `data/uploads/`
- Kein SQL-Backup gefunden

**Lösungsoptionen:**
1. Dateien neu hochladen über die Web-UI (empfohlen)
2. Prüfen, ob vorhandene Dateien automatisch neu verarbeitet werden können

        "contents": "@router.post(\n    \"/{persona_id}/documents\",\n    response_model=PersonaDocument,\n    status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED,\n    summary=\"Upload a document for a persona\",\n    description=\"\"\"\n    Upload a document file to be associated with a persona and processed for knowledge extraction.\n    \n    This endpoint accepts a file upload, stores it in persistent storage, and enqueues it for\n    asynchronous processing. The document will be processed to extract text, create chunks,\n    generate embeddings, and store them in the vector database for persona-related knowledge retrieval.\n    \n    **Parameters:**\n    - &#96;persona_id&#96;: The unique identifier of the persona to associate the document with (UUID format)\n    - &#96;file&#96;: The document file to upload (multipart/form-data, supports PDF, DOCX, TXT, etc.)\n    - &#96;uploaded_by&#96;: Optional identifier of who uploaded the document (default: \"persona-admin-ui\")\n    \n    **Returns:**\n    - The created document object with processing status \"processing\" and a unique document ID.\n    \n    **Note:** Processing happens asynchronously. Use the document status endpoint or list documents\n    to check processing progress. The document will be chunked, embedded, and made searchable\n    once processing completes. The persona cache is automatically invalidated after upload.\n    \"\"\"\n)\nasync def upload_persona_document(\n    persona_id: str,\n    file: UploadFile = File(...),\n    uploaded_by: str = Form(\"persona-admin-ui\"),\n    session: Session = Depends(get_db),\n) -&gt; PersonaDocument:\n    persona = _get_persona_or_404(session, persona_id)\n    contents = await file.read()\n    if not contents:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=\"File was empty\")\n    content_type = file.content_type or \"application/octet-stream\"\n    filename = file.filename or \"upload.bin\"\n    document_id = uuid4()\n    key = f\"personas/{persona_id}/documents/{document_id}/{filename}\"\n    \n    # Create document with processing status\n    document = Document(\n        id=document_id,\n        filename=filename,\n        content_type=content_type,\n        size_bytes=len(contents),\n        status=\"processing\",\n        object_key=key,\n        file_path=key,\n        persona_id=persona.id,\n        uploaded_by=uploaded_by,\n    )\n    session.add(document)\n    session.flush()\n    \n    # Create processing job\n    job = ProcessingJob(document_id=document.id, status=\"pending\", progress=0)\n    session.add(job)\n    session.commit()\n    \n    # Store file in filesystem (persistent storage for ingestion)\n    storage.upload(key=key, data=contents, content_type=content_type)\n    \n    # Get the persistent file path for ingestion (same as storage path)\n    from ..core.config import get_settings\n    settings = get_settings()\n    data_dir = Path(settings.data_dir)\n    persistent_file = data_dir / key.lstrip(\"/\")\n    \n    # Enqueue ingestion task with persistent file path\n    import structlog\n    logger = structlog.get_logger(__name__)\n    logger.info(\"document.upload.enqueue\", document_id=str(document.id), file_path=str(persistent_file), persona_id=str(persona_id))\n    enqueue_ingestion(str(document.id), str(persistent_file))\n    logger.info(\"document.upload.enqueued\", document_id=str(document.id))\n    \n    session.refresh(document)\n    persona_service.invalidate_cache(persona_id)\n    return persona_service.serialize_document(document, session=session)\n\n\n@router.get(\n    \"/{persona_id}/knowledge\",\n    response_model=List[PersonaKnowledgeEntrySchema],\n    summary=\"List knowledge entries for a persona\",\n    description=\"\"\"\n    Retrieve all manual knowledge entries that have been added to a persona.\n    \n    This endpoint returns a list of knowledge entries that were manually created and\n    associated with the persona. These entries complement the automatically extracted\n    knowledge from documents and can include domain-specific insights, observations,\n    or additional context about the persona.\n    \n    **Parameters:**\n    - &#96;persona_id&#96;: The unique identifier of the persona (UUID format)\n    \n    **Returns:**\n    - A list of knowledge entry objects, each containing:\n      - Entry ID and title\n      - Content text\n      - Optional metadata payload\n      - Creator information and timestamps\n    \n    **Note:** Knowledge entries are separate from document-derived knowledge chunks.\n    These are manually curated entries that provide additional context for the persona.\n    \"\"\"\n)",

        "contents": "\"\"\"\nMigration script to ingest existing TargetGroupKnowledgeEntry records.\n\nThis script finds all existing knowledge entries that don't have associated chunks\nand creates DocumentChunks, embeddings, and Qdrant vectors for them.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\n# Add parent directory to path\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]\nsys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / \"app\"))\n\nfrom uuid import UUID\n\nimport structlog\nfrom sqlalchemy import select\n\nfrom app.db import get_session\nfrom app.models import DocumentChunk, TargetGroupKnowledgeEntry\nfrom app.services.knowledge_ingestion import KnowledgeIngestionService\n\nlogger = structlog.get_logger(__name__)\n\n\ndef migrate_existing_knowledge_entries() -&gt; None:\n    \"\"\"Migrate all existing knowledge entries that don't have chunks yet.\"\"\"\n    logger.info(\"migration.knowledge.start\")\n\n    knowledge_service = KnowledgeIngestionService()\n    migrated_count = 0\n    error_count = 0\n\n    with get_session() as session:",

        "contents": "@router.post(\n    \"/upload\",\n    response_model=DocumentUploadResponse,\n    summary=\"Upload a document for processing\",\n    description=\"\"\"\n    Upload a document file for asynchronous processing and ingestion.\n    \n    This endpoint accepts a file upload, stores it in persistent storage, and enqueues it for processing.\n    The document will be processed asynchronously through the ingestion pipeline which includes:\n    - Text extraction and parsing\n    - Chunking and embedding generation\n    - Storage in Qdrant vector database\n    - Graph database integration\n    \n    **Parameters:**\n    - &#96;file&#96;: The document file to upload (supports various formats including PDF, DOCX, TXT, etc.)\n    \n    **Returns:**\n    - &#96;job_id&#96;: A unique identifier for the processing job. Use this to check the job status via the status endpoint.\n    \n    **Note:** Processing happens asynchronously. Use the returned &#96;job_id&#96; to poll the status endpoint for progress updates.\n    \"\"\"\n)\nasync def upload_document(\n    file: UploadFile = File(...),\n    session: Session = Depends(get_db),\n) -&gt; DocumentUploadResponse:\n    filename = file.filename or f\"upload-{uuid4().hex}.bin\"\n    document_id = uuid4()\n    key = f\"documents/{document_id}/{filename}\"\n    document = Document(\n        id=document_id,\n        filename=filename,\n        content_type=file.content_type or \"application/octet-stream\",\n        size_bytes=file.size or 0,\n        status=\"processing\",\n        file_path=key,\n        object_key=key,\n    )\n    session.add(document)\n    session.flush()\n\n    job = ProcessingJob(document_id=document.id, status=\"pending\", progress=0)\n    session.add(job)\n    session.commit()\n\n    contents = await file.read()\n\n    # Store file in filesystem (persistent storage for ingestion)\n    storage.upload(key=key, data=contents, content_type=document.content_type)\n    \n    # Get the persistent file path for ingestion (same as storage path)\n    from ..core.config import get_settings\n    settings = get_settings()\n    data_dir = Path(settings.data_dir)\n    persistent_file = data_dir / key.lstrip(\"/\")\n\n    enqueue_ingestion(str(document.id), str(persistent_file))\n\n    return DocumentUploadResponse(job_id=str(job.id))\n\n\n@router.get(\n    \"/{job_id}/status\",\n    summary=\"Get the status of a document processing job\",\n    description=\"\"\"\n    Retrieve the current status of a document processing job.\n    \n    This endpoint allows you to check the progress of a document that was uploaded for processing.\n    The status can be one of:\n    - &#96;pending&#96;: The job is queued and waiting to be processed\n    - &#96;processing&#96;: The document is currently being processed (includes progress percentage)\n    - &#96;completed&#96;: The processing finished successfully (includes the document ID)\n    - &#96;failed&#96;: The processing encountered an error (includes error reason)\n    \n    **Parameters:**\n    - &#96;job_id&#96;: The unique identifier of the processing job (returned from the upload endpoint)\n    \n    **Returns:**\n    - Status information including:\n      - Current status (&#96;pending&#96;, &#96;processing&#96;, &#96;completed&#96;, or &#96;failed&#96;)\n      - Progress percentage (0-100) when status is &#96;processing&#96;\n      - Document ID when status is &#96;completed&#96;\n      - Error reason when status is &#96;failed&#96;\n    \n    **Usage:** Poll this endpoint periodically to track processing progress until the status is either &#96;completed&#96; or &#96;failed&#96;.\n    \"\"\"\n)",
        "signatures": {},

          },
          {
            "text": "@router.get(",

          },
          {
            "text": "    \"/{job_id}/status\",",
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "text": "    summary=\"Get the status of a document processing job\",",
            "lineNumber": 90
          },
          {
            "text": "    description=\"\"\"",
            "lineNumber": 91
          },
          {
            "text": "    Retrieve the current status of a document processing job.",
            "lineNumber": 92
          },
          {
            "text": "    ",
            "lineNumber": 93
          },
          {
            "text": "    This endpoint allows you to check the progress of a document that was uploaded for processing.",
            "lineNumber": 94
          },
          {
            "text": "    The status can be one of:",
            "lineNumber": 95
          },
          {
            "text": "    - &#96;pending&#96;: The job is queued and waiting to be processed",

          },
          {
            "text": "    - &#96;processing&#96;: The document is currently being processed (includes progress percentage)",
            "lineNumber": 97
          },
          {
            "text": "    - &#96;completed&#96;: The processing finished successfully (includes the document ID)",
            "lineNumber": 98
          },
          {
            "text": "    - &#96;failed&#96;: The processing encountered an error (includes error reason)",
            "lineNumber": 99
          },
          {
            "text": "    ",
            "lineNumber": 100
          },
          {
            "text": "    **Parameters:**",
            "lineNumber": 101
          },
          {
            "text": "    - &#96;job_id&#96;: The unique identifier of the processing job (returned from the upload endpoint)",
            "lineNumber": 102
          },
          {
            "text": "    ",
            "lineNumber": 103
          },
          {
            "text": "    **Returns:**",
            "lineNumber": 104
          },
          {
            "text": "    - Status information including:",
            "lineNumber": 105
          },
          {
            "text": "      - Current status (&#96;pending&#96;, &#96;processing&#96;, &#96;completed&#96;, or &#96;failed&#96;)",
            "lineNumber": 106
          },
          {
            "text": "      - Progress percentage (0-100) when status is &#96;processing&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 107
          },
          {
            "text": "      - Document ID when status is &#96;completed&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 108
          },
          {
            "text": "      - Error reason when status is &#96;failed&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 109
          },
          {
            "text": "    ",
            "lineNumber": 110
          },
          {
            "text": "    **Usage:** Poll this endpoint periodically to track processing progress until the status is either &#96;completed&#96; or &#96;failed&#96;.",

        "contents": "class IngestionService:\ndef _ensure_collection(self) -&gt; None:\n,\n            )\n\n    def ingest(self, *, document_id: UUID, file_path: Path) -&gt; None:\n        file_path = file_path.resolve()\n        self._ensure_collection()\n        logger.info(\"ingest.start\", document_id=str(document_id), file_path=str(file_path))\n\n        with get_session() as session:\n            job: ProcessingJob | None = session.scalar(\n                select(ProcessingJob).where(ProcessingJob.document_id == document_id)\n            )\n            if not job:\n                # Create job if it doesn't exist\n                logger.warning(\"ingest.job_not_found_creating\", document_id=str(document_id))\n                job = ProcessingJob(document_id=document_id, status=\"pending\", progress=0)\n                session.add(job)\n                session.commit()\n                logger.info(\"ingest.job_created\", document_id=str(document_id))\n            else:\n                logger.info(\"ingest.job_found\", document_id=str(document_id), job_status=job.status, job_progress=job.progress)\n                # If job is already processing or completed, skip to avoid duplicate processing\n                if job.status == \"processing\":\n                    logger.warning(\"ingest.job_already_processing\", document_id=str(document_id), job_id=str(job.id))\n                    return\n                # If job is completed, reset it for retry\n                if job.status == \"completed\":\n                    logger.info(\"ingest.job_resetting_for_retry\", document_id=str(document_id), job_id=str(job.id))\n                    job.status = \"pending\"\n                    job.progress = 0\n                    job.error = None\n                    session.commit()\n            \n            # Set status to processing atomically\n            job.status = \"processing\"\n            job.progress = 5\n            session.commit()\n            \n            # Get document to check for persona_id and target_group_id\n            from ..models import Persona\n            document = session.get(Document, document_id)\n            if not document:\n                job.status = \"failed\"",

      "codeBlock": {

        },
        "contents": "@router.post(\n    \"/{target_group_id}/documents\",\n    response_model=PersonaDocument,\n    status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED,\n    summary=\"Upload a document for a target group\",\n    description=f\"\"\"\n    Upload a document file to be associated with a target group and processed for knowledge extraction.\n    \n    This endpoint accepts a file upload, stores it in persistent storage, and enqueues it for\n    asynchronous processing. The document will be processed to extract text, create chunks,\n    generate embeddings, and store them in the vector database. The chunks will be automatically\n    linked to the target group through TargetGroupSource relationships.\n    \n    **Parameters:**\n    - &#96;target_group_id&#96;: The unique identifier of the target group to associate the document with (UUID format)\n    - &#96;file&#96;: The document file to upload (multipart/form-data, supports PDF, DOCX, TXT, etc.)\n    - &#96;uploaded_by&#96;: Optional identifier of who uploaded the document (default: \"target-group-admin-ui\")\n    \n    **Returns:**\n    - The created document object with processing status \"processing\" and a unique document ID.\n    \n    **Note:** Processing happens asynchronously. Use the document status endpoint or list documents\n    to check processing progress. Once processed, document chunks will be automatically associated\n    with the target group and available for persona generation and knowledge retrieval.\n    \n    **Schemas:**\n    - Response: &#96;PersonaDocument&#96; (see {SCHEMA_SOURCE_PATH})\n    - Request: multipart upload fields documented in {TARGET_GROUP_DOC_SECTION}\n    \"\"\"\n)\nasync def upload_target_group_document(\n    target_group_id: str,\n    file: UploadFile = File(...),\n    uploaded_by: str = Form(\"target-group-admin-ui\"),\n    session: Session = Depends(get_db),\n) -&gt; PersonaDocument:\n    tg = _get_target_group_or_404(session, target_group_id)\n    contents = await file.read()\n    if not contents:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=\"File was empty\")\n    content_type = file.content_type or \"application/octet-stream\"\n    filename = file.filename or \"upload.bin\"\n    document_id = uuid4()\n    key = f\"target-groups/{target_group_id}/documents/{document_id}/{filename}\"\n\n    # Create document with processing status\n    document = Document(\n        id=document_id,\n        filename=filename,\n        content_type=content_type,\n        size_bytes=len(contents),\n        status=\"processing\",\n        object_key=key,\n        file_path=key,\n        target_group_id=tg.id,\n        uploaded_by=uploaded_by,\n    )\n    session.add(document)\n    session.flush()\n\n    # Create processing job\n    job = ProcessingJob(document_id=document.id, status=\"pending\", progress=0)\n    session.add(job)\n    session.commit()\n\n    # Store file in filesystem (persistent storage for ingestion)\n    storage.upload(key=key, data=contents, content_type=content_type)\n\n    # Get the persistent file path for ingestion (same as storage path)\n    from ..core.config import get_settings\n    settings = get_settings()\n    data_dir = Path(settings.data_dir)\n    persistent_file = data_dir / key.lstrip(\"/\")\n\n    #         "contents": "@router.post(\n    \"/{persona_id}/documents/{document_id}/retry\",\n    response_model=PersonaDocument,\n    summary=\"Retry ingestion for a failed document\",\n    description=\"\"\"\n    Retry the ingestion process for a document that previously failed or is stuck in processing.\n    \n    This endpoint resets the processing job status and re-enqueues the document for ingestion.\n    Useful when a document processing job failed due to transient errors or got stuck in\n    a processing state.\n    \n    **Parameters:**\n    - &#96;persona_id&#96;: The unique identifier of the persona (UUID format)\n    - &#96;document_id&#96;: The unique identifier of the document to retry (UUID format)\n    \n    **Returns:**\n    - The document object with reset status (\"processing\") and cleared error information.\n    \n    **Note:** The document's processing job is reset to \"pending\" status and re-enqueued.\n    Any previous error messages are cleared. The document must have a valid file path in storage.\n    The persona cache is automatically invalidated after retry.\n    \"\"\"\n)\ndef retry_persona_document_ingestion(\n    persona_id: str,\n    document_id: str,\n    session: Session = Depends(get_db),\n) -&gt; PersonaDocument:\n    \"\"\"Retry ingestion for a document that failed or is stuck.\"\"\"\n    persona = _get_persona_or_404(session, persona_id)\n    try:\n        document_uuid = UUID(document_id)\n    except ValueError as exc:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=\"Invalid document id\") from exc\n    document = session.get(Document, document_uuid)\n    if not document or document.persona_id != persona.id:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"Document not found\")\n    \n    if not document.file_path:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=\"Document file path missing\")\n    \n    # Get or create processing job\n    job = session.scalar(\n        select(ProcessingJob).where(ProcessingJob.document_id == document_uuid)\n    )\n    if not job:\n        job = ProcessingJob(document_id=document_uuid, status=\"pending\", progress=0)\n        session.add(job)\n    \n    # Reset job status\n    job.status = \"pending\"\n    job.progress = 0\n    job.error = None\n    document.status = \"processing\"\n    session.commit()\n    \n    # Get the persistent file path for ingestion\n    from ..core.config import get_settings\n    settings = get_settings()\n    data_dir = Path(settings.data_dir)\n    # document.file_path is relative to data_dir (e.g., \"personas/.../file.pdf\")\n    # Construct full path: data_dir / file_path\n    file_path_clean = document.file_path.lstrip(\"/\")\n    persistent_file = data_dir / file_path_clean\n    \n    #         "contents": "#!/bin/bash\n# Reset all databases for a fresh start with knowledge\n\nset -e\n\necho \"🚨 WARNING: This will delete ALL data from PostgreSQL, Qdrant, Neo4j, and Redis!\"\necho \"\"\necho \"🗑️  Starting database reset...\"\n\n# 1. PostgreSQL: Drop all tables\necho \"📊 Resetting PostgreSQL...\"\ndocker-compose exec -T postgres psql -U persona -d persona &lt;&lt;EOF\nDROP SCHEMA public CASCADE;\nCREATE SCHEMA public;\nGRANT ALL ON SCHEMA public TO persona;\nGRANT ALL ON SCHEMA public TO public;\nEOF\necho \"✅ PostgreSQL reset complete\"\n\n# 2. Qdrant: Delete all collections via Python API\necho \"🔍 Resetting Qdrant...\"\ndocker-compose exec -T persona-api python -c \"\nfrom qdrant_client import QdrantClient\nfrom app.core.config import get_settings\nsettings = get_settings()\nclient = QdrantClient(settings.qdrant_url, check_compatibility=False)\ncollections = client.get_collections()\nfor collection in collections.collections:\n    try:\n        client.delete_collection(collection.name)\n        print(f'  Deleted collection: {collection.name}')\n    except Exception as e:\n        print(f'  Error deleting {collection.name}: {e}')\nprint('✅ Qdrant reset complete')\n\" 2&gt;/dev/null || echo \"  Qdrant reset completed (may have errors if no collections exist)\"\necho \"✅ Qdrant reset complete\"\n\n# 3. Neo4j: Delete all nodes and relationships\necho \"🕸️  Resetting Neo4j...\"\ndocker-compose exec -T neo4j cypher-shell -u neo4j -p neo4j_password &lt;&lt;EOF\nMATCH (n) DETACH DELETE n;\nEOF\necho \"✅ Neo4j reset complete\"\n\n# 4. Redis: Flush all data\necho \"💾 Resetting Redis...\"\ndocker-compose exec -T redis redis-cli FLUSHALL\necho \"✅ Redis reset complete\"\n\n# 5. Recreate database schema from models\necho \"📋 Recreating database schema...\"\ndocker-compose exec -T persona-api python -c \"\nfrom app.db import Base, engine\nBase.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)\nprint('✅ Tables created from models')\n\" 2&gt;/dev/null || echo \"⚠️  Error creating tables from models\"\n\n# 6. Mark Alembic migrations as up-to-date\necho \"📝 Marking Alembic migrations as current...\"\ndocker-compose exec -T persona-api alembic stamp head 2&gt;/dev/null || echo \"⚠️  Error stamping migrations\"",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "def _process_directly(document_id: str, file_path: str) -&gt; None:\n    \"\"\"\n    Process ingestion directly without Celery (fallback mechanism).\n    \n    Args:\n        document_id: Document UUID\n        file_path: Path to the document file\n    \"\"\"\n    logger.info(\"enqueue.ingestion.processing_directly\", document_id=document_id, file_path=file_path)\n    \n    try:\n        file_path_obj = Path(file_path)\n        \n        if not file_path_obj.exists():\n            logger.error(\"enqueue.ingestion.file_not_found\", document_id=document_id, file_path=str(file_path_obj))\n            with get_session() as session:\n                job = session.scalar(\n                    select(ProcessingJob).where(ProcessingJob.document_id == UUID(document_id))\n                )\n                if job:\n                    job.status = \"failed\"\n                    job.error = f\"File not found: {file_path_obj}\"\n                    session.commit()\n            return\n        \n        # Update job status to processing\n        with get_session() as session:\n            job = session.scalar(\n                select(ProcessingJob).where(ProcessingJob.document_id == UUID(document_id))\n            )\n            if job:\n                job.status = \"processing\"\n                job.progress = 0\n                session.commit()\n        \n        # Process directly\n        ingestion_service.ingest(document_id=UUID(document_id), file_path=file_path_obj)\n        \n        logger.info(\"enqueue.ingestion.direct_processing_completed\", document_id=document_id)\n        \n    except Exception as exc:",

Chat API (Real-time Chat Service)\n\n**Pfad:** &#96;apps/chat-api/&#96;\n\n**Technologien:**\n- FastAPI\n- WebSocket\n- Anthropic Claude API\n- Vector Retrieval\n\n**Hauptfunktionen:**\n- Real-time Chat (WebSocket)\n- Persona Discovery\n- Persona Generation\n- Voice Streaming\n- Retrieval Agent Integration\n\n**Commands:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncd apps/chat-api\nuv sync\nuv run fastapi dev app/main.py --port 8001\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 4.         "contents": "# Backend Ingestion Fixes\n\n## Overview\n\nThis document describes the fixes and hardening applied to the document ingestion service to resolve upload failures and improve reliability.\n\n## Problem Statement\n\nDocument uploads were failing with file not found errors during ingestion:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nFileNotFoundError: File not found: /app/data/uploads/documents/...\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nAdditionally, tests were failing because the default data directory (&#96;/app/data/uploads&#96;) didn't exist in local development environments.\n\n## Root Causes\n\n1. **Hardcoded Paths**: &#96;StorageService&#96; and &#96;IngestionService&#96; assumed &#96;/app/data/uploads&#96; existed\n2. **Path Mismatch**: Uploads saved to one location, ingestion looked in another\n3. **No Error Recovery**: Ingestion failed silently when files weren't found\n4. **Test Environment**: Tests couldn't create directories under &#96;/app/&#96; (read-only filesystem)\n\n## Solutions\n\n### 1. Dynamic Data Directory Configuration\n\n**Before (&#96;apps/api/app/core/config.py&#96;):**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;python\ndata_dir: str = \"/app/data/uploads\"  # Hardcoded, fails locally\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**After:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;python\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom pydantic import Field\n\ndef _default_data_dir() -&gt; str:\n    \"\"\"Derive data_dir from project root, works in dev and Docker.\"\"\"\n    project_root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]\n    return str(project_root / \"data\" / \"uploads\")\n\nclass Settings(BaseSettings):\n    data_dir: str = Field(default_factory=_default_data_dir)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Benefits:**\n- Works in local development (uses project root)\n- Works in Docker (can override via &#96;DATA_DIR&#96; env var)\n- No hardcoded paths\n- Tests can use temporary directories\n\n### 2. Ingestion Service Hardening\n\n**Improvements in &#96;apps/api/app/services/ingestion.py&#96;:**\n\n#### Empty Chunk Handling\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;python\ncleaned_chunks = [chunk.text.strip() for chunk in elements if getattr(chunk, \"text\", \"\").strip()]\n\nif not cleaned_chunks:\n    logger.warning(\"ingest.no_chunks\", document_id=str(document_id))",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [

        "contents": "from __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom functools import lru_cache\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Literal\n\nfrom pydantic_settings import BaseSettings, SettingsConfigDict\n\n\nclass Settings(BaseSettings):\n    model_config = SettingsConfigDict(env_file=\".env\", env_file_encoding=\"utf-8\", extra=\"ignore\")\n\n    app_env: Literal[\"development\", \"staging\", \"production\"] = \"development\"\n    api_host: str = \"0.0.0.0\"\n    api_port: int = 8000\n\n    database_url: str\n    redis_url: str\n    qdrant_url: str\n    data_dir: Path = Path(\"./data/uploads\")\n\n    otel_exporter_otlp_endpoint: str | None = None\n    logfire_token: str | None = None\n\n    @property\n    def upload_dir(self) -&gt; Path:\n        \"\"\"Get the upload directory, creating it if it doesn't exist.\"\"\"\n        upload_path = self.data_dir\n        upload_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n        return upload_path\n\n\n@lru_cache\ndef get_settings() -&gt; Settings:\n    return Settings()  # type: ignore[call-arg]",

        "contents": "def migrate_existing_knowledge_entries() -&gt; None:\n\n    error_count = 0\n\n    with get_session() as session:\n        # Find all knowledge entries\n        entries = session.scalars(select(TargetGroupKnowledgeEntry)).all()\n        logger.info(\"migration.knowledge.found_entries\", count=len(entries))\n\n        for entry in entries:\n            # Check if chunk already exists\n            existing_chunk = session.query(DocumentChunk).filter(\n                DocumentChunk.knowledge_entry_id == entry.id\n            ).first()\n\n            if existing_chunk:\n                logger.info(\n                    \"migration.knowledge.already_migrated\",\n                    entry_id=str(entry.id),\n                    chunk_id=str(existing_chunk.id),\n                )\n                continue\n\n            try:\n                logger.info(\"migration.knowledge.ingesting\", entry_id=str(entry.id))\n                knowledge_service.ingest_knowledge_entry(entry.id)\n                migrated_count += 1\n                logger.info(\"migration.knowledge.success\", entry_id=str(entry.id))\n            except Exception as e:\n                error_count += 1\n                logger.error(\n                    \"migration.knowledge.failed\",\n                    entry_id=str(entry.id),\n                    error=str(e),\n                )\n\n    logger.info(\n        \"migration.knowledge.complete\",\n        migrated=migrated_count,\n        errors=error_count,\n        total=len(entries) if 'entries' in locals() else 0,\n    )\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    migrate_existing_knowledge_entries()",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./cleanup-docker-builds.sh",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 65
          }
        },
        "contents": "#!/bin/bash\nset -e\n\necho \"🧹 Cleaning up Docker builds and freeing space...\"\n\n# Step 1: Stop OrbStack if running\necho \"1️⃣ Stopping OrbStack...\"\nkillall -9 OrbStack 2&gt;/dev/null || echo \"OrbStack not running\"\nsleep 2\n\n# Step 2: Clean up OrbStack data (optional - be careful!)\necho \"2️⃣ Cleaning OrbStack cache...\"\nrm -rf ~/.orbstack/run/docker.sock 2&gt;/dev/null || true\n# Don't delete entire .orbstack directory as it contains important data\n\n# Step 3: Start OrbStack\necho \"3️⃣ Starting OrbStack...\"\nopen -a OrbStack\necho \"⏳ Waiting for OrbStack to start (30 seconds)...\"\nsleep 30\n\n# Step 4: Check if Docker is ready\necho \"4️⃣ Checking Docker connection...\"\nif ! docker ps &gt; /dev/null 2&gt;&amp;1; then\n    echo \"❌ Docker still not ready. Please check OrbStack manually.\"\n    echo \"   Try: open -a OrbStack\"\n    exit 1\nfi\n\necho \"✅ Docker is ready!\"\n\n# Step 5: Stop all containers\necho \"5️⃣ Stopping all containers...\"\ncd \"$(dirname \"$0\")/infrastructure\"\ndocker compose down 2&gt;/dev/null || echo \"No containers to stop\"\n\n# Step 6: Remove unused images, containers, networks, and volumes\necho \"6️⃣ Removing unused Docker resources...\"\ndocker system prune -a --volumes -f\n\n# Step 7: Show disk usage\necho \"\"\necho \"7️⃣ Docker disk usage after cleanup:\"\ndocker system df\n\n# Step 8: Remove old build cache\necho \"\"\necho \"8️⃣ Removing build cache...\"\ndocker builder prune -a -f\n\n# Step 9: Show final disk usage\necho \"\"\necho \"📊 Final Docker disk usage:\"\ndocker system df\n\necho \"\"\necho \"✅ Cleanup complete!\"\necho \"\"\necho \"🔄 Now restarting services...\"\ndocker compose up -d\n\necho \"\"\necho \"✅ Services restarted!\"\necho \"🌐 Test: http://192.168.50.101/admin/journeys\"",

uv run ruff check .\ncd apps/api &amp;&amp; uv run mypy .\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Testing:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Frontend\nnpm test --workspaces\n\n# Backend\ncd apps/api &amp;&amp; uv run pytest\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Git Workflow\n\n**Branches:**\n- &#96;main&#96;         "contents": "class QueueService:\n\n\n    def retry_failed_job(self, session: Session, job_id: str) -&gt; ProcessingJobDetailResponse:\n        \"\"\"Retry a failed processing job.\"\"\"\n        try:\n            job_uuid = UUID(job_id)\n        except ValueError:\n            raise ValueError(\"invalid_job_id\")\n\n        job = session.get(ProcessingJob, job_uuid)\n        if not job:\n            raise ValueError(\"job_not_found\")\n\n        if job.status != \"failed\":\n            raise ValueError(\"job_not_failed\")\n\n        # Get document\n        document = session.get(Document, job.document_id)\n        if not document:\n            raise ValueError(\"document_not_found\")\n\n        # Get file path\n        from pathlib import Path\n        from ..core.config import get_settings\n\n        settings = get_settings()\n        data_dir = Path(settings.data_dir)\n        file_path = data_dir / document.file_path.lstrip(\"/\")\n\n        if not file_path.exists():\n            raise ValueError(\"file_not_found\")\n\n        # Reset job status\n        job.status = \"pending\"\n        job.progress = 0.0\n        job.error = None\n        session.commit()\n\n        # Enqueue ingestion again\n        from worker.ingest import enqueue_ingestion\n\n        enqueue_ingestion(str(job.document_id), str(file_path))\n\n        return self.get_processing_job(session, job_id)",

**Lösung:** Dateien müssen neu hochgeladen werden, damit sie in der Datenbank registriert und verarbeitet werden.

**Optionen:**
1. Über die Web-UI: `https://192.168.50.101/` → Upload-Funktion nutzen
2. Per API: Dateien über die Upload-Endpunkte hochladen

**Status:**
- Datenbank: leer (0 personas, 0 target-groups, 0 documents)
- Dateisystem: Dateien vorhanden in `data/uploads/`
- Services: laufen (Backend-API, Chat-API, Indexing-API)

**Nächste Schritte:**
1. Über die Web-UI (`https://192.168.50.101/`) Dateien hochladen
2. Oder ich erstelle ein Script, das vorhandene Dateien scannt und neu verarbeitet

Delete processing job\n            session.execute",

        "contents": "**Lösung:**\n- Datenbank-Daten: Coolify's PostgreSQL/Redis Services haben automatische Persistence\n- Qdrant, Neo4j: Separate Volume-Configs in Coolify\n- File Uploads: Shared Volume oder S3-compatible Storage\n- HuggingFace Cache: Shared Volume zwischen allen Python Services\n\n---\n\n## Deployment-Strategie\n\n### Option A: Vollständige Migration (Empfohlen für Production)\n\nJeder Service wird als separate Coolify-App:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nCoolify Server\n├── Applications\n│   ├── persona-web (Next.js Frontend)\n│   ├── persona-api (FastAPI Backend)\n│   ├── chat-api (FastAPI Chat Service)\n│   ├── indexing-api (FastAPI Indexing Service)\n│   ├── persona-worker (Celery Worker)\n│   ├── indexing-worker (Celery Worker)\n│   ├── qdrant (Vector Database)\n│   ├── neo4j (Graph Database)\n│   └── tempo (Observability)\n├── Services\n│   ├── postgres (PostgreSQL 17)\n│   └── redis (Redis 7)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Option B: Hybrid (Empfohlen für Migration)\n\nKritische Services auf Coolify, Datenbanken extern:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nCoolify (Applications)\n├── persona-web\n├── persona-api\n├── chat-api\n├── indexing-api\n├── persona-worker\n└── indexing-worker\n\nExtern (Docker Compose oder Managed)\n├── postgres\n├── redis\n├── qdrant\n├── neo4j\n└── tempo\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## Service-Konfiguration\n\n### 1. PostgreSQL Service\n\n**Coolify Service:**\n- Type: PostgreSQL\n- Version: 17\n- Database Name: &#96;persona&#96;\n- User: &#96;persona&#96;\n- Password: (über Coolify Secrets)\n\n**Connection String:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nDATABASE_URL=postgresql+psycopg://persona:{POSTGRES_PASSWORD}@coolify-postgres:5432/persona\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Migrations:**\n- Initial Migration nach Deployment\n- Alembic in persona-api Container ausführen\n\n### 2. Redis Service\n\n**Coolify Service:**\n- Type: Redis\n- Version: 7\n- Password: (über Coolify Secrets)\n\n**Connection String:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nREDIS_URL=redis://:${REDIS_PASSWORD}@coolify-redis:6379/0\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 3. Qdrant (Separate App)\n\n**Docker Image:** &#96;qdrant/qdrant:v1.11.3&#96;",

        "contents": "#!/bin/bash\nset -e\n\necho \"🧹 Cleaning up Docker builds and freeing space...\"\n\n# Step 1: Stop OrbStack if running\necho \"1️⃣ Stopping OrbStack...\"\nkillall -9 OrbStack 2&gt;/dev/null || echo \"OrbStack not running\"\nsleep 2\n\n# Step 2: Clean up OrbStack data (optional - be careful!)\necho \"2️⃣ Cleaning OrbStack cache...\"\nrm -rf ~/.orbstack/run/docker.sock 2&gt;/dev/null || true\n# Don't delete entire .orbstack directory as it contains important data\n\n# Step 3: Start OrbStack\necho \"3️⃣ Starting OrbStack...\"\nopen -a OrbStack\necho \"⏳ Waiting for OrbStack to start (30 seconds)...\"\nsleep 30\n\n# Step 4: Check if Docker is ready\necho \"4️⃣ Checking Docker connection...\"\nif ! docker ps &gt; /dev/null 2&gt;&amp;1; then\n    echo \"❌ Docker still not ready. Please check OrbStack manually.\"\n    echo \"   Try: open -a OrbStack\"\n    exit 1\nfi\n\necho \"✅ Docker is ready!\"\n\n# Step 5: Stop all containers\necho \"5️⃣ Stopping all containers...\"\ncd \"$(dirname \"$0\")/infrastructure\"\ndocker compose down 2&gt;/dev/null || echo \"No containers to stop\"\n\n# Step 6: Remove unused images, containers, networks, and volumes\necho \"6️⃣ Removing unused Docker resources...\"\ndocker system prune -a --volumes -f\n\n# Step 7: Show disk usage\necho \"\"\necho \"7️⃣ Docker disk usage after cleanup:\"\ndocker system df\n\n# Step 8: Remove old build cache\necho \"\"\necho \"8️⃣ Removing build cache...\"\ndocker builder prune -a -f\n\n# Step 9: Show final disk usage\necho \"\"\necho \"📊 Final Docker disk usage:\"\ndocker system df\n\necho \"\"\necho \"✅ Cleanup complete!\"\necho \"\"\necho \"🔄 Now restarting services...\"\ndocker compose up -d\n\necho \"\"\necho \"✅ Services restarted!\"\necho \"🌐 Test: http://192.168.50.101/admin/journeys\"",
